intro: Big Win 777 uses 15 paylines in the base game. Diamond Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols, while Chance Wheel Scatter appears only on reels 1, 3 and 5; three Scatters trigger Chance Wheel with free spins or instant prizes of up to 777x the stake.

If Chance Wheel unlocks Big Win Free Spins, the round starts with 12 spins. Scatters can add spins or retrigger the wheel, while landed Wilds become sticky and duplicate upwards or downwards on subsequent spins until reaching the reel’s edge.
playn-go-big-win-777.editorial: Big Win 777 builds its bonus around Chance Wheel rather than one fixed mode: the wheel determines the reward, while sticky Wilds in Big Win Free Spins gradually move along reels and can expand the number of Wild positions.

features.title: Chance Wheel and Big Win Free Spins
features.description: Three Chance Wheel Scatters trigger the wheel; Big Win Free Spins award 12 spins, extra Scatters and sticky Wilds that duplicate along the reel to its edge.

features.title: Diamond Wild and 15 paylines
features.description: The ordinary mode has 15 paylines, while Diamond Wild substitutes for standard symbols in winning combinations.

features.title: Chance Wheel from three Scatters
features.description: The wheel Scatter appears only on reels 1, 3 and 5; three symbols trigger a wheel with Instant Prizes or Free Spins, including a separate reward of up to 777x the stake.

features.title: Big Win Free Spins and sticky Wilds
features.description: If the wheel unlocks Free Spins, 12 spins begin. Sticky Wild duplicates upwards or downwards until reaching the edge, while Scatters can award extra spins or retrigger the wheel.

intro: Fang City awards an instant prize for seven Moon Symbols anywhere on the grid. If those seven include a Mystery Moon, Mystery Reveal activates with one of five effects, including Collector and Converter.
Three to six Bonus Symbols award eight Free Spins but different starting multipliers: x1, x2, x5 or x10. A new Multiplier Symbol within the bonus can add to the Persistent Multiplier.
push-gaming-fang-city.editorial: Fang City separates ordinary seven-Moon collection from Mystery Reveal. Persistent Multiplier is not always active: it applies when new multipliers arrive during the bonus series.

features.title: Seven Moons
features.description: Seven Moon Symbols trigger an Instant Prize payout.

features.title: Mystery Reveal
features.description: If a Mystery Moon is present, the seven-symbol set can unlock Collector, Converter, Moon Multiplier or other effects.

features.title: Persistent Multiplier
features.description: In Free Spins, new multipliers add to the accumulated meter and enhance the corresponding wins.

intro: 9 Coins Grand Gold Edition continues the nine-position bonus system: Cash Infinity appears in the base game, remains until Hold the Jackpot triggers and helps activate coin collection.
Three bonus symbols in the middle row start three respins, resetting when a new coin appears. Filling every position awards this version’s Grand Jackpot of 1500x the stake.
wazdan-9-coins-grand-gold-edition.editorial: Grand Gold sits between 1000 Edition and Platinum in top-prize size, but the Chance Level and Cash Out features of later variants should not be attributed to it.

features.title: Three symbols on the middle row
features.description: Three bonus symbols unlock Hold the Jackpot with three respins; new landings reset the counter.

features.title: Cash Infinity
features.description: A symbol present before the bonus stays in position and contributes to subsequent collection alongside ordinary Cash values.

features.title: Grand Jackpot 1500x
features.description: The provider separately states a top prize of 1500x for filling the nine-position grid.

intro: In Book of Sun: Multichance, three Book Scatters award twelve free spins.
An expanding symbol is selected before the start for the entire bonus.
3-oaks-gaming-book-of-sun-multichance.editorial: Each retrigger unlocks another expanding symbol, up to nine.

features.title: Twelve free spins
features.description: Three Book Scatters trigger the bonus.

features.title: Expanding symbol
features.description: It pays independently of payline rules.

features.title: Retrigger
features.description: Every three Scatters add a new special symbol.

intro: VS Symbol expands into a Wild DuelReel if that expansion creates a win; two duellists compete for a multiplier, which then applies to all wins involving that reel.
Outlaw Symbol becomes a full Wild Reel and shoots up to six additional Wilds onto the grid; in Dusk ’Til Dawn, a full revolver unlocks DuelSpins with guaranteed VS Symbols.
hacksaw-gaming-duel-at-dawn.editorial: Duel at Dawn combines two ways of taking over an entire reel: DuelReel provides a multiplier through a duel, while Outlaw Reel scatters extra Wilds and drives DuelSpin progression in the higher bonus.

features.title: VS expands DuelReels
features.description: VS becomes a full Wild DuelReel only with a potential win. Outlaw and Sheriff duel over two multipliers, and the winner’s value applies to all related wins on that reel.

features.title: Outlaw Reel shoots new Wilds
features.description: Outlaw expands into a separate Wild reel on arrival and receives a revolver with between one and six bullets. These create Wilds in random positions without shooting another Outlaw.

features.title: Dusk ’Til Dawn and DuelSpin progress
features.description: Four FS symbols trigger Dusk ’Til Dawn: a full Outlaw revolver unlocks a DuelSpin with guaranteed VS symbols. Each successive one of four DuelSpins raises the minimum VS count from two to five.

intro: Big Win Cat acts as Wild. If identical stacked symbols completely fill any two of the three reels, the third receives a Free Re-Spin while the matching reels remain in place.
When the same symbol fills all nine positions, including Wild substitutions, Wheel of Multipliers triggers. The wheel immediately boosts the ordinary win with a multiplier of up to x10.
playn-go-big-win-cat.editorial: Big Win Cat uses a very compact structure: two complete stacked reels produce a re-spin, while a full 3×3 screen turns the same matching pattern into a separate Wheel of Multipliers.

features.title: Free Re-Spins and Wheel of Multipliers
features.description: Two full matching stacks lock and award a re-spin of the third reel, while a full screen of matching symbols triggers a multiplier wheel of up to x10.

features.title: Big Win Cat Wild
features.description: The cat symbol substitutes for ordinary symbols in payline combinations.

features.title: Two full stacks and a Free Re-Spin
features.description: Two matching stacks completely filling two of the three reels lock and award a respin of the third.

features.title: Wheel of Multipliers for a full screen
features.description: If all nine positions hold one symbol, including Wilds, a wheel opens that can increase the payout with a multiplier of up to x10.

intro: Fat banker combines two bonus routes: Fortune Link collects Bullion and multipliers on the grid, while separate free spins make the banker grow by collecting Wild Money Bags. Bullion and Silver Safe are not the same symbol.
In the base round, Red Car can add Wild Money Bags, Bullion or Silver Safe. In the bonuses, Gold Car sometimes helps on the final turn and adds suitable symbols.
push-gaming-fat-banker.editorial: Fat Banker’s main internal distinction is between Fortune Link with respins and the character-growth meter. Combining them into one Hold & Spin is incorrect.

features.title: Fortune Link
features.description: Starts with two spins; new Bullion or Multiplier Symbols reset the spin counter.

features.title: Fat Banker Free Spins
features.description: The banker collects Wild Money Bags, fills the growth meter and receives extra spins.

features.title: Red Car and Gold Car
features.description: The red car helps in the base game, while the gold car can add Wilds or instant prizes during bonuses.

intro: 9 Coins Grand Platinum Edition adds Chance Level and Cash Out to nine positions. Cash Infinity still stays on the grid until Hold the Jackpot, but some bonus-symbol values can be collected earlier.
Three bonus symbols in the centre trigger a respin series, while a full screen awards the Grand Jackpot of 2500x the stake. Chance Level increases the probability of bonus entry at a higher stake.
wazdan-9-coins-grand-platinum-edition.editorial: Platinum should not be described simply as Grand Gold with a different jackpot: it has Cash Out and Chance Level, absent from the original 9 Coins formula.

features.title: Chance Level
features.description: A separate setting allows a higher stake for more frequent bonus triggers.

features.title: Cash Out in the base game
features.description: Cash Out collects bonus-coin values and provides a separate way to receive a payout before Hold the Jackpot.

features.title: Grand Jackpot 2500x
features.description: Filling all nine bonus-grid cells awards 2500x; Diamond Edition has a different limit.

intro: Buddha Megaways varies six reels between two and seven symbols high: each spin offers between 64 and 117,649 ways to form a combination.
Winning cascades raise the multiplier by one step. In Free Spins, the accumulated multiplier does not reset between spins.
3-oaks-gaming-buddha-megaways.editorial: Buddha Megaways involves more than its 117,649 ways: reel heights change every time, while the bonus’s accumulating multiplier and risky Gamble Free Spins fundamentally distinguish it from ordinary payline slots.

features.title: Variable height on six reels
features.description: Each spin independently opens between two and seven positions per reel, changing the payout ways within a 64–117,649 range.

features.title: Cascades and multiplier
features.description: Winning symbols disappear, new ones fall into their places, and consecutive wins increase the multiplier by one with no stated upper limit.

features.title: Free Spins without a multiplier reset
features.description: In the bonus, successful cascades increase the multiplier, which remains until the entire series ends instead of resetting after each spin.

features.title: Gamble and Free Spins purchase
features.description: Awarded Free Spins can be wagered, risking their loss on failure. The provider also describes buying the round for 100 stakes.

intro: After a Cluster win, Super Cascades remove all ordinary symbols of the winning type and refill the cleared positions.
Every win fills the Blessing Bar; when activated, it adds Wild Symbols with multipliers, while subsequent fills increase either the Wild count or the accumulated multiplier.
hacksaw-gaming-dusk-princess.editorial: Dusk Princess connects its cascade grid to a progressing Blessing Bar: large clusters pay and bring the next group of Wild multipliers closer, which can then grow stronger itself.

features.title: Super Cascades on a cluster grid
features.description: A winning cluster removes all ordinary symbols of the same type, and new symbols fill the empty positions. One result can therefore trigger several further cascades within the same spin.

features.title: Blessing Bar awards growing Wilds
features.description: Winning hits fill the Blessing Bar; a full meter adds Wild Symbols with multipliers. New activations can increase either the Wild count or their multiplier, which adds together within one combination.

features.title: Dusk, Lunar and Night Court
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock Dusk Court with a progressing Blessing Bar; four unlock Lunar Court with stronger starting Wilds. In Night Court with five FS symbols, the meter stays full and activates on every bonus spin.

intro: Coin Collection gathers each Coin symbol into a visual pile above the reels; the meter itself does not change the odds, but a Coin can trigger an Instant Bonus with a fixed Mini, Minor, Major or Grand reward.

Two full stacks of matching symbols trigger Re-spin of Luck for the third reel. Matching symbols across the whole screen unlock Wheel of Pawsperity, offering multiplier prizes of up to x20 and Bonus prizes, including Grand Bonus.
playn-go-big-win-cat-pawsperity.editorial: Big Win Cat Pawsperity retains the compact three-reel pattern but adds an independent Coin branch. Re-spin of Luck works towards matching every stack, while Wheel of Pawsperity converts the full screen into a separate reward.

features.title: Instant Bonus, Re-spin of Luck and Wheel of Pawsperity
features.description: Coins can award a fixed Instant Bonus, two matching stacks trigger a re-spin of the third reel, and a full screen unlocks Wheel of Pawsperity with prizes and a multiplier of up to x20.

features.title: Coin Collection and Instant Bonus
features.description: Coin Symbols visually fill a pile above the reels without changing the probability. An individual Coin can award a fixed Mini/Minor/Major/Grand reward.

features.title: Re-spin of Luck
features.description: Two reels with full stacks of matching symbols trigger a Re-Spin of the third reel while the first two retain their contents.

features.title: Wheel of Pawsperity
features.description: A full screen of one symbol unlocks a wheel with multiplier prizes of up to x20 and separate Bonus prizes, including Grand Bonus.

intro: Fat Drac has a 5×5 grid with 40 paylines and a special vampire symbol acting as both Scatter and Reveal. It can reveal an ordinary symbol or a bat that collects an Instant Prize Bubble.
Seven visible prize bubbles move one position on every turn. The vampire with a Goblet triggers free spins, while Coffin opens a separate reward pick.
push-gaming-fat-drac.editorial: Unlike Fat Santa, Fat Drac reaches the bonus through Goblet, and goblets rather than festive Wilds feed the vampire’s size meter.

features.title: Fat Drac Reveal
features.description: The vampire reveals a paying symbol or a Bat that takes the value of one bubble.

features.title: Coffin Pick
features.description: Up to five Bats can be revealed in the base game; in the bonus, the pick can award an additional Goblet or spins.

features.title: Fat Bat and growth meter
features.description: Fat Bat collects visible Instant Prize Bubbles, while collected Goblets develop the meter and extend the bonus.

intro: 9 Lions uses nine separate reels and has no standard paylines. Instead of one bonus, it offers Lions Bonus and Dragons Bonus, while Block Symbols Mode allows the next round to be influenced.
The provider highlights adjustable Low, Standard and High volatility. The lion and dragon bonuses belong to the original game rather than the later Hold the Jackpot version.
wazdan-9-lions.editorial: The original 9 Lions should not inherit Cash Infinity or One Click 2 Grand from 9 Lions Hold the Jackpot. Its game structure differs despite the similar visual theme.

features.title: Lions Bonus
features.description: A separate Hold & Collect mode that gathers bonus values rather than ordinary payline wins.

features.title: Dragons Bonus
features.description: A second independent dragon-themed bonus branch, listed separately from Lions Bonus by the provider.

features.title: Block Symbols Mode
features.description: The symbol-blocking mode allows part of the grid to be held for the next spin.

intro: Chili Coins uses a 3×3 fruit grid with five paylines and a central Red Chili Collect that gathers visible coins, including fixed jackpots.
Collect landing with coins on both sides triggers three respins; the bonus combines up to three held Collect symbols and accumulating cell multipliers.
3-oaks-gaming-chili-coins.editorial: Chili Coins involves more than Hold & Win: Chili Feature can intervene in coin collection, while sticky multipliers in one position grow through repeat appearances. These are two separate ways to increase the bonus result.

features.title: Red Chili Collect and jackpots
features.description: Collect appears only on the second reel and gathers Coin Bonus Symbol amounts, including Mini, Minor, Major and Grand values.

features.title: Random Chili Feature
features.description: During Collect, this feature can assign jackpots, add coins or place x2–x6 multipliers in random positions.

features.title: Hold & Win with three Collect symbols
features.description: A central Collect together with Bonus symbols on the first and third reels triggers three respins; up to three Collect symbols can lock in the mode.

features.title: Sticky multipliers and Chili Metre
features.description: A cell multiplier starts at x2 and grows by one on a repeat landing; a new activation resets three respins. Filling Chili Metre can unlock the bonus through an alternative route.

intro: A VS Symbol contributing to a win expands into a Wild DuelReel and triggers a duel; the winner’s multiplier applies to all wins involving that reel.
A Cash Prize can be attached to either duellist: the cash value pays only if the character associated with it wins.
hacksaw-gaming-dynasty-of-death.editorial: Dynasty of Death adds a second duel outcome to the familiar DuelReel: beyond the reel multiplier, the result can decide a separate Cash Prize, while higher bonuses guarantee these prizes or multiple VS symbols at once.

features.title: DuelReel selects a winner
features.description: A winning VS expands into a Wild DuelReel and triggers a duel between two characters. The winner’s multiplier applies to every combination involving that reel.

features.title: Cash Prize depends on the duel outcome
features.description: A separate Cash Prize value can be attached to one duellist. It pays after ordinary wins only if the character associated with the prize wins.

features.title: King’s Defence, Queen’s Dominion, Immortal Mate
features.description: Three FS symbols award ten King’s Defence spins with more frequent DuelReels; four award Queen’s Dominion with a Cash Prize on every DuelReel. Five FS symbols unlock Immortal Mate with two guaranteed VS symbols on every spin.

intro: Wins form from three or more symbols vertically or horizontally. After a win, the combination’s middle symbol becomes Martina Wild for band symbols or a band-logo Wild for other symbols; within one cascade, the win multiplier grows by one after each new combination.

Band symbols charge a meter that triggers the Concert feature: after an additional spin, band members perform Solos in turn. Clearing the entire grid awards 8 Free Spins; the triggering spin’s multiplier carries into the bonus as its base, while Martina Solo activates after every free spin.
playn-go-black-mamba.editorial: Black Mamba links grid clears, symbol transformations and a growing cascade multiplier to four Solo effects. Concert uses Solos as a separate sequence, while Free Spins carry the accumulated multiplier into the round instead of resetting to x1.

features.title: Concert, Solo features and Free Spins
features.description: Winning combinations create Wilds and increase the cascade multiplier; the charge meter triggers Concert, while clearing the entire grid awards 8 Free Spins with the base multiplier carried over.

features.title: Vertical and horizontal matches
features.description: Three or more matching symbols vertically or horizontally award a win; the combination’s middle symbol becomes Martina or band-logo Wild.

features.title: Cascade multiplier
features.description: Each new paying combination in a cascade increases the multiplier by one.

features.title: Concert, four Solos and Free Spins
features.description: Band Symbols charge the Concert meter with four Solo effects. Clearing the entire grid unlocks eight Free Spins in which the triggering spin’s multiplier remains as the base.

intro: Fat Santa uses a 5×5 grid with 50 paylines. Santa appears on a sleigh and can leave Christmas Pie Wilds that help complete combinations.
Santa appearing with one or more pies triggers free spins. Collected pies feed Santa: he grows and gradually adds more turns.
push-gaming-fat-santa.editorial: This is an early Fat-series game: Wild Christmas Pies drive progression here rather than the Bullion or prize bubbles of later games.

features.title: Sleigh Feature
features.description: Santa can randomly fly above the grid and add Christmas Pie Wilds to the reels.

features.title: Free Spins
features.description: Santa and Wild Christmas Pie together take the game into a bonus with a growing character.

features.title: Bonus Buy
features.description: Entry to free spins can be purchased in markets where the feature is permitted.

intro: 9 Lions Hold the Jackpot reinterprets the series around nine bonus positions and two separate modes. Hold the Jackpot collects symbols towards the Grand Jackpot, while 9 Lions Bonus uses One Click 2 Grand.
Cash Infinity adds held cash symbols, Chance Level changes the entry chance with a different stake, and Bonus Matrix controls progress towards bonus events.
wazdan-9-lions-hold-the-jackpot.editorial: This is not a remaster of the original 9 Lions: it has Cash Infinity, Bonus Matrix and One Click 2 Grand, while the old Dragons Bonus should not be transferred automatically.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot
features.description: A separate nine-cell bonus where Bonus Symbols collect and the Grand Jackpot is reached.

features.title: 9 Lions Bonus and One Click 2 Grand
features.description: The second independent mode centres on a choice linked to One Click 2 Grand.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Chance Level
features.description: Cash Infinity locks and helps bonus progress, while Chance Level affects the frequency of bonus entry.

intro: China Festival presents Hold & Win on a 5×3 grid with 25 paylines and three separate firecracker meters above the reels.
Green, red and purple meters trigger Boost, Double and Collect respectively. The bonus can apply several features together.
3-oaks-gaming-china-festival.editorial: China Festival differs from Hold & Win with one universal enhancement: which firecracker meters have filled before the bonus matters, because Boost, Double and Collect perform different actions and can combine.

features.title: Three coloured Firecracker meters
features.description: Green, red and purple symbols charge the matching meters above the grid; filling them activates Hold & Win with the selected features.

features.title: Boost, Double and Collect
features.description: Boost adds a random value to every symbol, Double doubles current values, and Collect gathers the grid’s contents.

features.title: Mystery Symbols and jackpots
features.description: Mini, Minor and Major are possible in the bonus; Mystery can reveal a jackpot, bonus symbol or one of three features. Filling the grid leads to Grand.

features.title: Buy Bonus and Super Bonus
features.description: An ordinary bonus purchase provides up to three random feature symbols; Super Bonus guarantees three random feature symbols. Purchase availability depends on the market.

intro: VS Symbol expands into an Outlaw DuelReel with the winning duellist’s multiplier; a separate Bounty VS triggers a Bounty Hunter versus Outlaw duel.
If the Bounty Hunter wins, she takes the opponent’s multiplier and can continue duelling several more times, after which the combined Multiplier applies to the entire reel.
hacksaw-gaming-epic-bullets-and-bounty.editorial: Epic Bullets and Bounty strengthens the original mechanic through a more aggressive Bounty Duel chain rather than a new payout type: a successful Bounty Hunter can collect several multipliers before the reel is calculated.

features.title: Outlaw and Bounty DuelReels in the Epic version
features.description: Ordinary VS expands into a Wild DuelReel with the winning Outlaw’s multiplier. Bounty VS brings Bounty Hunter and Outlaw into a fight: the winning hunter can take his multiplier and continue the duel series.

features.title: True Grit and Four Shots to Freedom
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger True Grit with a choice between Gamble and ten Free Spins with Progressive Bounty Hunter Multipliers. Four FS symbols award Four Shots to Freedom with DuelSpins and VS symbols from a separate meter.

features.title: Go Ahead, Make Her Day is the Epic Bonus
features.description: Five FS symbols unlock the Epic Bonus with ten spins: DuelSpin Level 1 is active from the first spin, and the progressive Bounty Hunter multiplier applies. These are Epic-version rules rather than those of the base Bullets and Bounty.

intro: Blazin' Bullfrog uses a 5×3 grid and 243 payways. A Scatter on reel 2, 3 or 4 triggers BLAZIN’ RE-SPIN, where landed Scatters turn into expanding WILD SCATTER symbols.

Additional expanding WILD SCATTER symbols can appear during BLAZIN’ RE-SPIN. They substitute for ordinary symbols and stay sticky until the feature ends; the official Play’n GO page separately states that this re-spin cannot retrigger.
playn-go-blazin-bullfrog.editorial: Blazin' Bullfrog makes the central reels both the trigger and the expansion area: one Scatter already starts the re-spin, after which sticky expanding Wild Scatters can quickly occupy more positions, but the series remains a one-off without a retrigger.

features.title: BLAZIN’ RE-SPIN
features.description: A Scatter on reels 2–4 triggers a re-spin, becomes a sticky expanding WILD SCATTER and can receive additional expanding Wild Scatters within the same feature.

features.title: Scatter only in the central area
features.description: A Scatter on reel 2, 3 or 4 triggers the special BLAZIN’ RE-SPIN.

features.title: Expanding WILD SCATTER
features.description: The triggering Scatter expands into a full-reel Wild; new expanding Wild Scatters can be added in the mode.

features.title: Sticky Wild and no retrigger
features.description: Expanded WILD SCATTER symbols stay until the feature ends, but a retrigger of this series is officially unavailable.

intro: Fire Hopper uses a 7×7 grid with clusters of at least five symbols and cascades. A fire frog jumps to Fireflies and Instant Prizes, leaving a Golden Frog Wild.
Each jump increases the main frog’s multiplier by one. A Bonus Firefly beside Wild Fire Frog triggers seven free spins, during which the frog remains on the grid.
push-gaming-fire-hopper.editorial: In this game, distinguish the ordinary Golden Frog Wild left after a jump from the main frog with its accumulated multiplier.

features.title: Leaping Frog
features.description: Jumps to Fireflies create Golden Frog Wilds and increase the main frog’s multiplier.

features.title: Instant Prizes
features.description: The frog takes a visible Instant Prize, and its multiplier applies to the amount.

features.title: Seven Free Spins
features.description: The bonus begins when a special firefly Scatter is collected; the frog’s multiplier remains throughout the series.

intro: 9 Tigers uses three reels and eight paylines rather than a nine-coin bonus grid. Tiger Bonus is the central event in its Chinese garden setting.
A separate gamble game is available after winning combinations. The provider confirms RTP of 96.15% and a maximum win of 1000x, but does not describe Cash Infinity or Hold the Jackpot here.
wazdan-9-tigers.editorial: Unlike 9 Lions, the nine in 9 Tigers does not mean nine separate reels: the tigers have three reels and eight paylines.

features.title: Three reels and eight paylines
features.description: Combinations are read across eight paylines within a classic three-reel grid.

features.title: Tiger Bonus
features.description: A signature tiger bonus highlighted by Wazdan in the game’s feature list.

features.title: Gamble game
features.description: After a win, Unique Gamble Feature offers an attempt to increase the amount.

intro: Coin Express combines a classic 5×3 fruit grid with five paylines and Hold & Win, where six gold coins trigger three respins.
Each new coin locks and resets the counter, while Collect can gather all visible coin values, including fixed jackpots.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-express.editorial: Coin Express has two important routes to Hold & Win: six Gold Coins landing together and gradually filling Coin Metre. Its bonus Collector distinguishes it from simple coin accumulation.

features.title: Six coins and three respins
features.description: Six Gold Coin Bonus Symbols trigger Hold & Win; the original coins stay in place, while new ones lock and reset the respin count.

features.title: Collector Coin
features.description: During the bonus, Collect totals all visible Coin Bonus and Jackpot Symbol values rather than only those on its payline.

features.title: Mini, Minor, Major and Grand
features.description: Coins with three fixed jackpots appear in the bonus; filling the entire grid can lead to Grand x5000 the stake.

features.title: Coin Metre
features.description: Bonus Symbols charge a separate coin meter, providing a second route to Hold & Win that does not require six coins landing together.

intro: After a Cluster win, cells beneath winning symbols become Divine Squares; Hand of Zeus activates them and reveals Bronze, Silver and Gold Coins.
Zap of Zeus multiplies Coin and Vessel of Wealth values in neighbouring cells, while Vessel of Wealth gathers all Coin and other Vessel Symbol values on the grid.
hacksaw-gaming-epic-ze-zeus.editorial: Epic Ze Zeus builds a chain of three roles: a win creates Divine Squares, Hand of Zeus turns them into Coins, then Zap and Vessel modify and collect cash values on the grid.

features.title: Divine Squares and Hand of Zeus
features.description: After a win, cells beneath paying symbols are marked as Divine Squares. Hand of Zeus activates these positions and reveals Bronze, Silver and Gold Coins with cash values.

features.title: Zap of Zeus and Vessel of Wealth
features.description: Zap of Zeus increases coin and Vessel of Wealth values in neighbouring cells by up to a tenfold multiplier. Vessel of Wealth gathers all Coin and other Vessel values on the grid.

features.title: Three different Epic Ze Zeus bonus stages
features.description: Three FS symbols award eight What If Zeus Was One of Us spins; four award twelve Ze Zeus Take the Wheel spins. Five FS symbols unlock Superstar: Hand of Zeus is guaranteed on every spin, and only Silver or Gold Coins are available.

intro: Diamond Scatter appears on reels 1, 3 and 5 and unlocks Free Spins. A separate Win Spin feature starts with two or three Scatters: two award one Win Spin, and three award five.

If a Win Spin produces no payout, a Re-Spin begins with a multiplier that grows by one after each new re-spin until the first win. A new Scatter adds another Win Spin, and the feature’s total limit is 20 Win Spins.
playn-go-blinged.editorial: Blinged uses a guaranteed Win Spin as a sequence towards a result: an empty spin does not end the attempt but moves into a re-spin with a growing multiplier. Feature progress therefore depends on non-winning repeats and additional Scatters.

features.title: Win Spins and a growing Re-Spin Multiplier
features.description: 2–3 Scatters award 1 or 5 Win Spins; an empty Win Spin becomes a re-spin with a growing multiplier, while extra Scatters can bring the series to 20 Win Spins.

features.title: Diamond Scatter and Win Spins
features.description: Scatter appears on reels 1, 3 and 5; two Scatters award one Win Spin, while three award five Win Spins.

features.title: Re-Spin Multiplier until a win
features.description: If a Win Spin produces no payout, a new Re-Spin begins and the multiplier increases by one after every non-winning repeat.

features.title: Win Spin extensions and limit
features.description: A new Scatter adds another Win Spin; the feature is limited to 20 Win Spins in total.

intro: Fire Pig Push Ways combines instant prizes with Hot Zones. Symbols in marked zones split into two parts, increasing the available ways to win.
Fire Pig on the first or sixth reel collects Cash and Jackpots on the central reels. Three or more Bonus Symbols trigger Free Spins; more entry symbols mean a higher starting Fire Pig multiplier.
push-gaming-fire-pig-push-ways.editorial: Unlike ordinary collect slots, Hot Zone geometry and the Fire Pig meter are both linked to accumulation here, but they do not replace each other.

features.title: Fire Pig Collector
features.description: A pig on an outer reel gathers visible cash values and jackpots from the central reels.

features.title: Hot Zones
features.description: Symbols split in four-position zones, adding new payout ways.

features.title: Free Spins Progression
features.description: Every four collected Fire Pigs increase the multiplier and add spins.

intro: Arcade uses three reels, one payline and a retro presentation. Unlike grid-based coin collectors, its result is read from one combination.
Reels Blocking adds complexity: the player can block reels before spinning. Mini Bonus and a card-based gamble game form two other independent ways to increase the result.
wazdan-arcade.editorial: Arcade balances an extremely simple payline with manual reel control. Reels Blocking should not be presented as automatic Hold & Win.

features.title: One payline
features.description: Three reels and exactly one payline exclude complex cluster or ways combinations.

features.title: Reels Blocking
features.description: The mode allows some reels to be blocked, adding a manual choice to the next spin.

features.title: Mini Bonus and Gamble
features.description: Mini Bonus is a separate reward, while Gamble offers an attempt to increase a win already received.

intro: Coin Lamp brings coin accumulation into an Arabian tale: four bonus symbols on the central line activate a respin series.
In the bonus, a magic lamp randomly places between two and five multipliers, while symbol collection gradually opens three more rows.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-lamp.editorial: Grid expansion is the main branching point here. Lamp multipliers increase individual position values, but the Grand opportunity comes after opening every row and filling 24 cells, rather than simply receiving one large multiplier.

features.title: Central-line trigger
features.description: Four symbols on the middle row unlock a bonus with respins and cash Coin Bonus Symbols.

features.title: Collect and Mystery
features.description: Collect gathers all visible values. Mystery can reveal Bonus, Collect or Jackpot, while a separate Mystery Jackpot reveals Mini, Minor or Major.

features.title: Magic lamp multipliers
features.description: On a random respin, the lamp can place between two and five multipliers of up to x10; multipliers in the same cell combine.

features.title: Three extra rows and Power Bonus
features.description: Symbol collection opens three rows, expanding the grid to 24 cells. Super and Power Bonus guarantee a starting multiplier effect, while Power starts with every row open.

intro: VS Symbol expands into a DuelReel and pits two duellist multipliers against each other; the winner’s value applies to the entire Wild reel.
Three or more FS symbols become FS DuelReels: two free-spin values duel on each reel, the winning values add together, and Upgrade can raise the bonus level.
hacksaw-gaming-eternal-duel.editorial: Eternal Duel carries the duel principle into bonus triggering itself: both Wild-reel multipliers and free-spin values compete, with the latter combining to form the round’s length.

features.title: DuelReel with a multiplier duel
features.description: A successful VS expansion occupies an entire Wild reel and stages a duel between two characters. The winner’s multiplier applies to combinations involving the resulting DuelReel.

features.title: FS DuelReels determine bonus length
features.description: Three or more FS symbols become FS DuelReels, where two Free Spins values compete. Winning numbers add together, while additional Upgrades can raise the upcoming bonus’s level.

features.title: Hades Havoc, Zeus Fury and Eternal Destruction
features.description: Hades Havoc awards at least six spins with multiplier progress above and below. Zeus Fury boosts Wilds through Reel Multipliers, while Eternal Destruction guarantees special symbols and a DuelReel on every spin.

intro: Three Scatters trigger Free Spins. In the bonus, Collector Boats randomly light up above the reels and gather Instant Prize symbols directly beneath the active boat.
If both boats line up above one reel, Mega Catch gathers every Instant Prize on the current grid. A separate Golden Lobster in Mega Catch can award x1000 the total bet.
playn-go-boat-bonanza.editorial: Boat Bonanza builds its bonus around two boats’ positions relative to cash fish symbols. An ordinary activation collects only prizes beneath a particular boat, while both boats meeting above one reel turns local collection into a grid-wide Mega Catch.

features.title: Collector Boats and Mega Catch
features.description: Free Spins activate Collector Boats; both boats matching above one reel collect all Instant Prizes, while Golden Lobster can award x1000 the total bet.

features.title: Collector Boats above the reels
features.description: In Free Spins, Collector Boats activate randomly and take Instant Prize symbols beneath the reel where the boat has stopped.

features.title: Mega Catch when boats meet
features.description: If two Collector Boats line up above one reel, Mega Catch gathers cash symbols from the whole grid rather than only beneath the boat.

features.title: Golden Lobster
features.description: In Mega Catch, a separate Golden Lobster can award x1000 the total bet. This is a feature prize rather than a verified overall maximum win.

intro: Fish 'n' Nudge centres its value collection on Net Symbol, which appears as a vertical four-cell stack and moves down one position after every turn.
Fisherman acts as Wild and Collector: inside the net, he gathers every visible Instant Prize. Three Bonus Symbols trigger free spins without a fixed turn count.
push-gaming-fish-n-nudge.editorial: The original’s distinction is a growing shared multiplier counter: each subsequent respin adds +1, and the series continues while at least one net remains on the grid.

features.title: Nudging Net
features.description: The net moves down after each spin and immediately takes prize fish landing inside it.

features.title: Fisherman Collector
features.description: A fisherman inside Net gathers all visible Instant Prize values.

features.title: Bonus without a fixed length
features.description: Respins continue until every net disappears, while the overall multiplier grows.

intro: Back to the 70's uses five reels and 20 paylines. Its retro disco setting combines with free spins in which a selected bonus symbol expands across a reel.
Scatter provides entry to Free Spins, while Expanding Bonus Symbol belongs specifically to the bonus series. The provider describes neither Hold the Jackpot nor Cash Infinity in this game.
wazdan-back-to-the-70s.editorial: Back to the 70's differs from other Wazdan retro slots through its expanding bonus symbol, a more specific mechanic than simply a seventies theme.

features.title: 20 paylines
features.description: Five reels form ordinary combinations on 20 paylines without dynamic ways or cascades.

features.title: Scatter triggers Free Spins
features.description: A special Scatter unlocks free spins; no trigger count or probability is inserted without a verified rule.

features.title: Expanding Bonus Symbol
features.description: A separate selected symbol can occupy an entire reel in the bonus mode.

intro: Coin Princess x1000 pays for eight or more matching symbols anywhere on a 6×5 grid, then triggers a cascade of new symbols.
Cash multiplier coins of x2–x1000 add together after the final cascade. In Free Spins, the overall multiplier accumulates throughout the bonus mode.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-princess-x1000.editorial: Coin Princess x1000 should not be judged by one x1000 coin: base-game multipliers add together for one spin’s result, while Free Spins carry those values into the shared counter for subsequent winning cascades.

features.title: Scatter Pays and cascades
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols anywhere on the 6×5 grid pay; paid symbols disappear and new ones replace them.

features.title: Coin Multipliers x2–x1000
features.description: Multiplier coins can land in the base game; multiple values add together and apply to the combined win after cascades finish.

features.title: Free Spins with Total Multiplier
features.description: In the bonus, winning coins add values to an overall multiplier that stays active throughout the Free Spins series.

features.title: Super Free Spins
features.description: The official page describes bonus purchases in selected markets and Super Free Spins with a starting multiplier of at least x10.

intro: Evil Eye activates Evil Spread when it lands beneath a winning symbol: it marks the win and chooses a rightward or downward direction, then stretches the symbols to the grid’s edge.
In Wicked Night, Evil Eyes gather multipliers in the direction of their gaze and add them to reel multipliers; a gaze crossing another Evil Eye additionally boosts every reel.
hacksaw-gaming-evil-eyes.editorial: Evil Eyes centres on directional win expansion: one eye can turn a local combination into a long strip of matching symbols, while the bonus turns the same idea into collecting multipliers along lines of sight.

features.title: Evil Eye and directional Evil Spread
features.description: If Evil Eye lands beneath a winning symbol, it marks the combination and spreads that symbol rightwards or downwards to the edge. A rightward spread can be followed by a second downward pass.

features.title: Wicked Night collects multipliers by gaze
features.description: In Wicked Night, the eye looks in different directions and gathers multipliers caught in its beam into individual reel values. When two Evil Eyes intersect, every reel receives an extra multiplier.

features.title: Graveyard and Wicked Epic Drop
features.description: Graveyard removes low-paying symbols that have already participated in Evil Spread from future spins. Wicked Epic Drop can turn one ordinary spin into a one-off Wicked Night round with guaranteed multiplier collection.

intro: On the 5×4 grid, two Festive Fishing Boats can activate randomly and collect Instant Win fish beneath the corresponding reel. If both boats meet above one reel, Mega Catch gathers every Instant Win fish on the grid.

Three or more Scatters trigger Free Spins, where the boats stay active on every spin. In the bonus, Swordfish boosts the Mega Catch Multiplier meter and can add multipliers together with extra Free Spins.
playn-go-boat-bonanza-christmas.editorial: Boat Bonanza Christmas retains the series’ two-boat setup but makes it persistent within Free Spins. Swordfish provides the main additional branch: it develops Mega Catch through a multiplier meter and extra spins rather than a separate reward.

features.title: Festive Fishing Boats and Mega Catch Multiplier
features.description: Two boats collect Instant Win fish, meeting on one reel triggers Mega Catch, and Swordfish raises Mega Catch Multiplier and adds spins in Free Spins.

features.title: Festive Fishing Boats
features.description: On the 5×4 grid, two festive boats collect Instant Win fish beneath the corresponding reel; the boats meeting awards Mega Catch.

features.title: Free Spins with persistent boat activation
features.description: Three or more Scatters unlock Free Spins, where both boat features are available on every spin.

features.title: Swordfish and Mega Catch Multiplier
features.description: Swordfish within Free Spins develops the Mega Catch Multiplier meter and can award extra multipliers or spins.

intro: Fish 'n' Nudge Big Catch retains moving nets, Instant Prize Fish and Fisherman but changes the bonus structure. Nets lock in place during Free Spins, while multipliers are tracked separately above each reel.
The boat can add and lock new Nets, while Boost increases a particular reel’s multiplier. The series has no fixed spin count and ends when no nets remain.
push-gaming-fish-n-nudge-big-catch.editorial: The sequel differs from the original Fish 'n' Nudge chiefly through per-column multipliers and a boat that locks nets; these should not be replaced with the earlier version’s single counter.

features.title: Locked Nets
features.description: Nets remain in position during Free Spins and continue collecting Fish Symbols.

features.title: Boost Symbol
features.description: Increases only the corresponding reel’s multiplier.

features.title: Boat Symbol
features.description: Can add new Net Symbols and lock them, extending the bonus structure.

intro: BARs&7s uses three reels and eight paylines, with only BAR and seven in its ordinary symbol paytable. Winning paylines run horizontally, vertically and diagonally.
After a successful combination, Gamble offers a choice of a BAR or seven laser. This is not a Scatter-bonus slot: the provider emphasises the minimal symbol count and gamble game.
wazdan-bars7s.editorial: BARs&7s is interesting as a highly reduced retro setup. Free spins or cascades should not be invented for it: its distinctive feature is the laser Gamble.

features.title: Two symbol types
features.description: The main grid is limited to BAR and 7; combinations are calculated across eight paylines on three reels.

features.title: Eight multidirectional paylines
features.description: Paylines can run horizontally, vertically and diagonally, distinguishing the game from a simple slot with one central payline.

features.title: Laser Gamble game
features.description: After a win, a BAR or 7 laser is chosen for a risk round, which can repeat according to its own rules.

intro: Coin UP Volcano brings the 3 Oaks volcano theme to a 4×3 grid. The official site confirms an August 2026 release; this version differs from the 2023 Coin Volcano on a 3×3 grid.

The Coin UP system is linked to cash symbols and increasing values in the bonus. The currently available page does not disclose exact multipliers or jackpot thresholds, so these are not presented as verified.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-up-volcano.editorial: The separate Coin UP name matters: rules for random multipliers and Ultra Bonus should not be copied from the older Coin Volcano as though it were the same game. Only the verified grid and coin-accumulation mode are retained here.

features.title: Separate 4×3 grid
features.description: Four columns and three rows distinguish this version from the original 3×3 Coin Volcano.

features.title: Coin UP and cash symbols
features.description: The mechanic uses prize coins whose values can increase under the game’s rules.

features.title: Volcano-themed bonus
features.description: Bonus accumulation is the main game element; unverified numerical jackpots are not added.

intro: After a win, Super Cascades remove the ordinary symbols involved; Medusa remains on the grid through the cascade, while winning high-paying symbols can become Petrified and fall down.
At the end of the cascade, Petrified symbols reveal their own multipliers, after which Medusa can additionally multiply the combined win.
hacksaw-gaming-eye-of-medusa.editorial: Eye of Medusa links cascades to deferred calculation: high-paying symbols do not simply disappear after a win, but turn to stone, collect at the bottom and reveal multipliers only after the sequence ends.

features.title: Super Cascades retaining Medusa
features.description: Ordinary winning symbols disappear in Super Cascades and are replaced. Medusa can survive the removal series, allowing the cascade sequence to continue within the same spin.

features.title: Petrified and two multiplier layers
features.description: Winning high-paying symbols near Medusa turn to stone and fall down. After cascades end, Petrified symbols reveal their own multipliers, while Medusa separately boosts the overall result.

features.title: Snakes & Stones and Gorgon’s Gold
features.description: Three or four FS symbols unlock Snakes & Stones with ten or twelve spins and more frequent Medusa. Five FS symbols award Gorgon’s Gold with twelve spins and a growing minimum Medusa multiplier.

intro: On the 5×4 grid, two Fishing Boats activate randomly and gather Instant Win fish beneath them. If both boats line up above one reel, Colossal Catch takes every Instant Win fish symbol on the reels.

Three or more Scatters trigger progressive Free Spins, where the boats stay active. Swordfish appears only in this round: catching it raises the Colossal Catch Multiplier meter and adds multipliers and extra Free Spins.
playn-go-boat-bonanza-colossal-catch.editorial: Boat Bonanza Colossal Catch extends the basic two-boat formula through a progressing Free Spins meter. Matching boat positions provide mass collection, while Swordfish gradually increases the value of later Colossal Catch events and extends the bonus at the same time.

features.title: Colossal Catch and Swordfish Multiplier
features.description: Matching boats collect every Catch Symbol, while Swordfish raises Colossal Catch Multiplier and adds extra spins in Free Spins.

features.title: Two Fishing Boats and Colossal Catch
features.description: On the 5×4 grid, boats collect Instant Win fish beneath them. Both meeting above one reel triggers collection across the whole grid.

features.title: Progressive Free Spins
features.description: Three or more Scatters unlock Free Spins, during which both boats stay active.

features.title: Swordfish and a separate meter
features.description: Swordfish appears in the bonus series: catching it raises the Colossal Catch Multiplier meter, adds multipliers and can extend Free Spins.

intro: Generous Jack starts a round with one open row and three positions for Chips and Duds. Chips carry digits, and neighbouring numbers form a combined prize: adjacent 7 and 1 award 71×.
Jack Symbols open extra rows with four, five and six spaces. Collected Jack Symbols fill a free-spins meter up to ten turns.
push-gaming-generous-jack.editorial: The distinctive idea is reading adjacent digits as one number rather than simply using multipliers. Push-Up opens extra rows in advance at a higher stake.

features.title: Number Chips
features.description: Digits on neighbouring chips combine into a composite Instant Prize value.

features.title: Expanding Reels
features.description: Jack Symbols gradually open new grid rows.

features.title: Free Spins and Push-Up
features.description: Every row is open in the bonus, while paid Push-Up allows a taller grid in the base game.

intro: Beach Party uses five reels and 20 paylines. The dartboard acts as Scatter: it can pay anywhere and trigger up to 15 free spins.
The bonus has a growing win multiplier. A separate Wild depicted by two women helps ordinary combinations but is not the same symbol as Scatter.
wazdan-beach-party.editorial: Free spins matter more here than the outdoor setting: the growing multiplier changes the series result. Beach Party Hot shares a similar theme but does not state the same Free Spins mode.

features.title: Dartboard Scatter
features.description: The dartboard can pay without a strict payline and unlocks up to 15 free spins.

features.title: Growing multiplier
features.description: Bonus Free Spins have an increasing win multiplier.

features.title: Wild and Gamble
features.description: Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols, while a separate gamble game is available after a successful round.

intro: Coin UP: Hot Fire is a compact 3×3 slot with a central payline. Three suitable bonus symbols trigger three respins, with every new prize symbol resetting the counter.
During the bonus, COLLECT gathers other coin values, MYSTERY reveals new values or jackpots, and MULTI UP increases prizes through multipliers.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-up-hot-fire.editorial: Hot Fire’s distinction is the combination of Coin UP, Multi UP and Collect rather than the reel count. Lightning’s thunder-themed Super Multi UP should not be transferred unless Wazdan/3 Oaks separately confirms it here.

features.title: Three initial respins
features.description: Suitable symbols in the central row trigger a bonus with three respins, resetting with new coins.

features.title: Collect and Mystery
features.description: Collect totals prize symbols on the grid, while Mystery reveals extra values and jackpots.

features.title: Coin UP and Multi UP
features.description: Coin UP increases coin values, while Multi UP applies bonus multipliers to the corresponding symbols.

intro: Super Cascades remove every instance of a winning symbol from the grid and trigger new falls; Wild Panda Multipliers substitute for ordinary symbols and multiply together when several Pandas contribute to one payline.

In Never Say No To Panda, unused Wild Pandas enter Panda Collector and return on winning paylines. In Jumping Pandas, the first Pandas remain as persistent Hoppers and change position between cascades and spins.
hacksaw-gaming-eye-of-the-panda.editorial: Eye of the Panda combines Super Cascades with mobile Wild multipliers: one bonus stores them off-grid until a suitable win, while the other makes a persistent group continually jump around the grid.

features.title: Super Cascades and multiplying Wild Pandas
features.description: After a winning payline, Super Cascades remove all symbols of the involved type from the grid. Wild Panda carries a multiplier, and multiple Panda values on one winning line specifically multiply together.

features.title: Never Say No To Panda and Collector
features.description: In this bonus, Wild Pandas without a win enter Panda Collector and remain there until a winning payline appears. They then return and apply their multipliers; on the final spin, they emerge even without an existing payline.

features.title: Jumping Pandas and persistent Hoppers
features.description: In the separate Jumping Pandas bonus, the first Wild Pandas become persistent Hoppers that remain between spins and move around the grid. This differs from storing symbols in Panda Collector.

intro: Up to two boats take part in Catch Feature and gather Instant Prize values from Catch Symbols beneath them. Croc Carnage can raise Catch Symbol values during collection; Blue Boat uses Depth Charge for a guaranteed hidden prize, while Red Boat uses Spear Shot to select a separate Catch Symbol on the grid.

Three or four Croc Coins trigger a re-spin with held coins, while five Croc Coins unlock Sobek’s Rage Lock’n Spin. New Croc Coins and Catch Symbols stay in place in this bonus, with revealed multipliers ranging from x2 to x10.
playn-go-boat-bonanza-croconile.editorial: Boat Bonanza CrocoNile! departs substantially from the series’ ordinary Mega Catch setup: each boat receives its own action, while Croc Coins lead to a second bonus layer with lock'n spin and separate multipliers.

features.title: Catch Feature and two boats
features.description: Up to two boats gather Instant Prizes from Catch Symbols beneath them. Blue and red boats have different additional actions.

features.title: Croc Carnage, Depth Charge and Spear Shot
features.description: Croc Carnage increases Catch Symbol values; Blue Boat uses Depth Charge for a hidden prize, while Red Boat selects a separate Catch through Spear Shot.

features.title: Croc’N Spin with 3–4 coins
features.description: Three or four Croc Coins award a respin with landed coins held, helping progress towards a larger bonus.

features.title: Sobek’s Rage with five Croc Coins
features.description: Five coins trigger Lock’n Spin: Croc Coins and Catch Symbols lock, while revealed x2–x10 multipliers increase the corresponding Instant Prizes.

intro: Giga Jar uses a 7×7 grid, groups of at least five matching fruits and cascades. Wild Jar contributes to payouts, increases its own multiplier by +1 and moves to a neighbouring cell after a win.
Snowball can break a giant fruit measuring up to 4×4, while Ice Breaker can remove several symbol types. Activating three Wild Jars and the cascade meter unlocks a separate 2×2 Giga Jar.
push-gaming-giga-jar.editorial: Giga Jar is an independent spin-off rather than a copy of Jammin' Jars 2: its central 2×2 figure cycles between sleep and awakening with new cascades.

features.title: Wild Jar
features.description: Moves around the grid after a successful cluster and increases its individual multiplier.

features.title: Snowball and Ice Breaker
features.description: The first adds large fruits, while the second clears up to three ordinary symbol types.

features.title: Giga Jar Feature
features.description: The 2×2 figure activates for three cascades; subsequent clusters can then raise its multiplier through levels up to x50.

intro: Beach Party Hot retains the summer theme but offers a retro five-reel grid with 20 paylines, without the original Beach Party’s provider-stated Free Spins with a growing multiplier.
A coloured beach ball acts as Scatter and pays regardless of position, while Unique Gamble offers repeated doubling after an ordinary win.
wazdan-beach-party-hot.editorial: Despite closely related names, Beach Party Hot has a much simpler mechanic: Scatter and Gamble are separately confirmed, while the original Beach Party’s free spins should not be transferred here.

features.title: Beach ball Scatter
features.description: Scatter can pay regardless of reel position and is not a standard Wild.

features.title: Five reels, 20 paylines
features.description: Ordinary payouts form on fixed paylines without an unusual grid.

features.title: Unique Gamble
features.description: The provider describes doubling a win in Gamble up to seven consecutive times.

intro: Coin UP: Lightning uses an electric-themed 3×3 grid. Three matching symbols on an active payline unlock three respins, with new bonus symbols resetting the counter each time.
Coin UP, Super Coin UP, Multi UP and Super Multi UP work on the top row during the bonus. Separate Ultra and Thunder Bonuses are available, while filling the entire grid can award Grand x500.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-up-lightning.editorial: This instalment is substantially more complex than Hot Fire: super modifiers and two enhanced bonuses are confirmed separately. Grand x500 is a conditional full-grid jackpot rather than a guaranteed win from three symbols.

features.title: Three respins and Grand x500
features.description: New coins reset three respins, while filling all nine positions provides a chance to receive Grand.

features.title: Four upper boosters
features.description: Coin UP and Super Coin UP increase values, while Multi UP and Super Multi UP multiply them.

features.title: Ultra/Thunder and Sticky Coins
features.description: Separate enhanced modes exist alongside coins held until bonus entry.

intro: If Speaker Symbols appear on at least two different reels, Speaker Mechanic finds the winning paylines connecting them and replaces all symbols within those lines with one matching paying symbol.
With a win present, X Symbol reveals a Global Multiplier for the entire spin; in the higher bonus, new values add to the already accumulated global multiplier.
hacksaw-gaming-feel-the-beat.editorial: Feel the Beat first reshapes whole winning paylines through Speaker Mechanic, then can scale the result with one X multiplier. Speakers gain Wild replacements in the bonuses, while Global Multiplier can progress.

features.title: Speaker Mechanic reshapes paylines
features.description: When at least two Speaker Symbols land on different reels, the winning paylines connecting them are replaced with one paying symbol. Speakers on one reel can also fill the gap between them.

features.title: X Symbol reveals Global Multiplier
features.description: With a win present, X Symbol reveals a multiplier affecting the entire spin. Even if Speaker replaces the X itself, its value applies before that replacement.

features.title: Pump Up the Jam and Get Your Booty
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock ten Pump Up the Jam Spins, where Speaker can create Wilds. Four FS symbols award Get Your Booty on the Floor: new X symbols add values to a progressive Global Multiplier.

intro: On the 5×4 grid, three or more Scatters trigger Free Spins. Before they begin, the player chooses one of eight fish hiding a Free Spins Enhancement: it can add Catch Symbols, increase the spin count or change other round parameters.

In the base game, the fisherman can randomly collect Instant Prize fish beneath his reel, pull out a Mystery Prize or trigger Surf’n Catch. In Surf’n Catch, he moves from left to right across the reels and collects every Instant Prize fish along the way.
playn-go-boat-bonanza-down-under.editorial: Boat Bonanza Down Under emphasises one fisherman and an enhancement choice before Free Spins rather than two boats. Base-game Instant Prize Collection periodically becomes Surf’n Catch, while the bonus trail adds new picks and retriggers with a growing multiplier.

features.title: Instant Prize Collection
features.description: The fisherman above the reels can randomly gather fish beneath one reel or pull out a hidden Mystery Prize; the result is not always a prize.

features.title: Surf’n Catch
features.description: In a separate feature, the fisherman starts at the first reel and moves right, collecting Instant Prize fish on every reel along his route.

features.title: Free Spins and choosing one of eight fish
features.description: Three or more Scatters on the 5×4 grid unlock Free Spins; choosing one of eight fish before the start determines the hidden enhancement.

features.title: Free Spins Trail and repeat enhancements
features.description: The bonus trail can offer new picks, extra spins and retriggers with an increasing multiplier.

intro: Goat Getter offers Coin Pots with Instant Prizes. Ten or more Coin Pots on the grid award an immediate payout, while six coins can unlock Coin Drop after ordinary combinations finish.
In Coin Drop, Mystery Boxes containing Coin, Bonus or Dud fall from above. Three Bonus Symbols unlock Free Spins, where Goat collects Instant Prizes and fills a growth meter.
push-gaming-goat-getter.editorial: Six and ten Coin Pots serve different purposes here: the first count can award an extra Coin Drop, while the second provides an immediate reward.

features.title: Coin Drop
features.description: Six Coin Pots can trigger falling boxes after other wins finish.

features.title: Goat Collector
features.description: The goat collects Instant Prize values on the grid and adds to the progression meter.

features.title: Goat meter and Gamble
features.description: Every five Goat Symbols add a bonus level and a spin; a separate gamble wheel can change the starting spin count.

intro: Beauty Fruity uses nine separate positions without paylines: at least four matching symbols anywhere on the grid are needed for a win. This is not an ordinary payline fruit slot.
The game has nine free spins with a x3 multiplier and a separate Love Spins mode collecting female symbols. Block Symbols Mode allows positions to be held before the next turn.
wazdan-beauty-fruity.editorial: Beauty Fruity’s three modes should remain distinct: four matching symbols define base calculation, Love Spins handles collection, and Free Spins uses a constant x3 multiplier.

features.title: Four matching symbols
features.description: A combination pays when at least four matching symbols appear anywhere on the nine-position grid.

features.title: Nine Free Spins x3
features.description: Free spins apply a x3 multiplier to all ordinary wins in the series.

features.title: Love Spins and blocking
features.description: Love Spins centres on collecting the woman symbol, while Block Symbols Mode allows individual positions to be held.

intro: The original Coin Volcano uses a compact 3×3 grid: three symbols on the central payline unlock a three-respin bonus.
Sticky Coin helps assemble the trigger, while Volcano Multiplier can place up to nine multipliers on the reels within the bonus.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-volcano.editorial: The original Coin Volcano should not be confused with Coin Volcano 2: the first game has a 3×3 grid and Ultra Bonus without the sequel’s described Boost Bonus starting at x5.

features.title: Sticky Coin before bonus entry
features.description: Sticky Coin remains held until respins begin, helping collect three bonus symbols in the central row.

features.title: Bonus, Collect and Mystery
features.description: During respins, Coin Bonus symbols carry values, Collect totals them, Mystery can reveal a symbol, and Mystery Jackpot reveals Mini, Minor or Major.

features.title: Volcano Multiplier
features.description: A random eruption places between one and nine multipliers; filling the grid can unlock the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Ultra Bonus and Volcano Metre
features.description: Ultra Bonus can start randomly with guaranteed Volcano Multiplier activation, while filling Volcano Metre provides another entry to the ordinary bonus.

intro: Fist Symbol activates only if its expansion creates a win, then grows upwards into a Wild Fist Reel to the reel’s upper edge.
If Fist passes through an opposing fighter or Wild, it receives a multiplier; multiple values on one Fist Reel add together, as do multipliers from several Fist Reels in one combination.
hacksaw-gaming-fighter-pit.editorial: Fighter Pit makes vertical expansion depend on reel contents: Fist Reel works as both Wild and a route through opposing fighters, each capable of adding a multiplier.

features.title: Wild Fist Reels and team hits
features.description: A red or green Fist expands upwards only when it becomes part of a win. Passing through an opposing fighter or Wild adds a multiplier, while multiple Fist Reels add their values on one payline.

features.title: Showdown and Victory Points
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock ten Showdown Free Spins. Hitting an opposing fighter earns a team point; three Victory Points trigger Epic Drop and raise Victory Level, which determines the guaranteed Fist count.

features.title: Ultimate Showdown enhances the start
features.description: Four FS symbols trigger Ultimate Showdown, where both teams begin at Victory Level 4+ instead of 3+. At level 5+, Epic Drop guarantees five Fists of the winning colour, but those landed Fists do not themselves earn points.

intro: Three or more Tomb Scatters trigger 10 Free Spins. One ordinary symbol is selected as Expanding Symbol and expands on its reels when enough instances are present; retriggers are possible up to a total limit of 80 spins.

In the base game, Gold Staters fill GO Collect meter and can unlock Treasure Vault. Hold N Spin starts with 3 re-spins: new Staters reset the counter to 3, and after completion an optional Treasure Gamble either doubles or loses the Vault total; up to four gambles are available.
playn-go-book-of-dead-go-collect.editorial: Book of Dead GO Collect keeps Expanding Symbol as a separate Free Spins branch, while GO Collect works only in the base game and leads to Treasure Vault. This keeps the classic Book mechanic separate from Staters, with extra risk appearing after Hold N Spin through Treasure Gamble.

features.title: Tomb Scatter and 10 Free Spins
features.description: Three or more Tomb Scatters award ten Free Spins with a selected Expanding Symbol; retriggers are capped at 80 total spins.

features.title: Gold Staters and GO Collect
features.description: In the base game, Staters on symbols fill a separate indicator leading to Treasure Vault; this system is not used in Free Spins.

features.title: Treasure Vault: Hold N Spin
features.description: The separate bonus starts with three respins. New Staters lock and reset the attempt counter to three.

features.title: Treasure Gamble after Vault
features.description: After coins are counted, the entire current amount can be risked up to four times for a double; losing means losing that amount.

intro: Happy Bamboo is a compact Bamboo-series slot with a separate Panda Pot. Ordinary Mystery Bamboo reveals paying symbols or Wilds, while the golden variant reveals coins, a collector, multipliers and Mystery Jackpot.
Collecting Golden Coins in Panda Pot can trigger Hold and Respin. A wheel selects the starting multiplier before the mode, then nine positions reveal as new Mystery Symbols are held.
push-gaming-happy-bamboo.editorial: Happy Bamboo should not be described through Big Bamboo’s mechanic: it has a different grid, nine separate bonus positions and progression through Panda Pot.

features.title: Mystery Bamboo Reveal
features.description: Ordinary bamboo reveals paying symbols, Wild or Golden Bamboo.

features.title: Golden Mystery Reveal
features.description: Golden bamboo can reveal Coin, Collector, Multiplier or Jackpot.

features.title: Panda Pot Hold & Respin
features.description: Accumulated Golden Coins can unlock a nine-position mode with a wheel-selected multiplier and held Mystery symbols.

intro: Bell Wizard is a payline slot with five reels and nine paylines. The jester icon acts as Wild, while three or more bell Scatters provide entry to free spins.
A separate x2 multiplier symbol applies in the bonus series. Bells provide entry to Free Spins, while jester Wild helps ordinary combinations: these symbols have different jobs.
wazdan-bell-wizard.editorial: Bell Wizard has a compact bonus setup: bell Scatters and x2 in free spins, without multi-layered Hold the Jackpot or accumulating Cash Infinity.

features.title: Three bell Scatters
features.description: Three or more Scatters unlock Free Spins rather than acting as a Wild that substitutes for ordinary symbols.

features.title: x2 multiplier in the bonus
features.description: During free spins, a separate multiplier symbol can double the corresponding win.

features.title: Jester Wild
features.description: Jester Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols when forming paylines across five reels.

intro: Coin Volcano 2 expands the volcano slot to 3×5: filling the middle payline with suitable symbols unlocks three respins, while Sticky Coin can lock beforehand and help trigger the bonus.
Hold & Win features Mini, Minor and Major coins, Mystery and Collector. An eruption can add up to nine Volcano Multipliers, while purchased Boost Bonus guarantees multipliers from x5.
3-oaks-gaming-coin-volcano-2.editorial: Do not transfer the original 3×3 Coin Volcano’s conditions to the sequel. This has a larger grid, Sticky Coin and two special bonus modes: Ultra appears randomly, while Boost is purchasable in selected regions. Grand is linked to filling the grid rather than one Mystery landing.

features.title: Sticky Coin and the middle payline
features.description: A special coin locks in the base game; filling the middle row unlocks three Hold & Win respins.

features.title: Mystery, Jackpot and Collect
features.description: During respins, Mystery becomes a bonus or jackpot symbol, Collect gathers values, and a full screen can award Grand.

features.title: Volcano Multipliers and Boost
features.description: An eruption adds up to nine multipliers, repeat values on a cell combine, and Boost starts them at x5.

intro: Bombs and Lasers are the main win mechanic: they destroy positions in different patterns, paying symbols in those positions immediately add payouts to the Total Win Bar, and each activation is followed by a cascade refilling the gaps.

FS Symbols are protected by a Shield and require three hits; Alien Attack gathers activated multipliers into a Progressive Multiplier, while Extermination carries them into a continuously active Progressive Global Multiplier.
hacksaw-gaming-fire-my-laser.editorial: Fire my Laser calculates wins through grid destruction rather than an ordinary payline: Bombs and Lasers punch through the grid in sequence, each waiting for a new cascade, so one chain can activate subsequent devices.

features.title: Bombs and Lasers blast the grid
features.description: Small and Big Bombs affect 3×3 and 5×5 areas, while X-Laser and Super Laser fire diagonally. Destroyed paying symbols award payouts, then cascades can activate subsequent devices.

features.title: Shields hide multipliers and the bonus
features.description: Protective Shields require several hits, but Super Laser removes them immediately. Destroying protected multipliers boosts the Total Win Bar, while a revealed FS triggers the corresponding bonus mode.

features.title: Alien Attack and Extermination
features.description: Removing protection from Alien Mind FS unlocks eight Alien Attack Spins with a Progressive Multiplier when replenished. Power Core FS triggers twelve Extermination Spins, where Progressive Global Multiplier applies every spin.

intro: Six Coin Scatters trigger Lock’n Gold. Coins stay sticky, new Coins reset the counter to three re-spins, and each Coin flips at the end to reveal a multiplier from x1 to x10; filling the entire grid awards a fixed x500 total bet payout.

Three or more Fish Scatters trigger Reward Spins. A Wheel determines the starting spin count and multiplier before the round; Wild Multipliers increase the overall multiplier, while new Fish Scatters add spins up to a total limit of 65.
playn-go-bubblin-riches.editorial: Bubblin’ Riches has two independent bonus paths: Lock’n Gold centres on sticky Coin multipliers and filling the grid, while Reward Spins develops an overall multiplier through Wilds and extra spins. Separately, Greedy Goldfish can randomly award one of the stated prizes of up to x1000.

features.title: Lock’n Gold from six Coin Scatters
features.description: Coins lock, while new coins reset the counter to three respins. Each reveals a x1–x10 multiplier after the bonus.

features.title: Grand for a full Lock’n Gold grid
features.description: Filling the coin-bonus grid awards a separate fixed payout of x500 the total stake; this should not be equated with the overall maximum win.

features.title: Reward Spins from Fish Scatters
features.description: Three or more Fish Scatters open the Wheel: it assigns starting spins and a multiplier that then grows through Wild Multipliers.

features.title: Extending Reward Spins
features.description: New Fish Scatters add spins up to a combined limit of 65. Random Greedy Goldfish can separately award an instant prize.

intro: Hearts Highway combines classic 20 paylines with rewards for Hearts anywhere on the grid. Four Hearts award an Instant Prize, while ten trigger the top payout tier.
A mini slot machine on the first or fifth reel can add hearts; machines on both edges activate an enhanced Heart Slot. Three Scatters unlock Progressive Free Spins with Golden Hearts.
push-gaming-hearts-highway.editorial: This is more than hearts replacing Scatters: in the bonus, individual columns can turn entirely into Hearts after three Golden Hearts are collected.

features.title: Instant Hearts
features.description: Four or more Hearts award increasing fixed payouts without reference to traditional paylines.

features.title: Slot Machine and Heart Slot
features.description: An edge machine adds Hearts, while a pair of machines can add substantially more.

features.title: Progressive Free Spins
features.description: Three Golden Hearts unlock a reel of hearts for the rest of the series and award an extra spin.

intro: Bells of Fortune uses sixteen independent positions without ordinary paylines and separates Hold the Jackpot from Bells of Fortune Bonus Game. Four bonus symbols in the central positions trigger three respins.
The second bonus branch begins after Bells Matrix fills: the player chooses prize gates and receives a top-jackpot opportunity through Click 2 Grand. Cash Infinity locks before the bonus.
wazdan-bells-of-fortune.editorial: 16 positions and two separate bonuses distinguish Bells of Fortune from nine-position 9 Coins and 9 Bells. Other games’ trigger conditions should not be transferred here.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot on 16 positions
features.description: Four bonus symbols in the central area trigger three resetting respins for collecting values.

features.title: Bells Matrix and gate picks
features.description: A filled matrix unlocks a separate bonus with gate picks and Click 2 Grand.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Chance Level
features.description: Cash Infinity locks on the grid, while Chance Level offers several ways to increase bonus probability at a higher stake.

intro: Crystal Scarabs places blue and gold scarabs on an Egyptian 5×4 grid: Boost gathers the cash values of blue Bonus Symbols.
Hold & Win adds an upper row with Plus, Multiplier and Transform to ordinary and gold scarabs, while Free Spins increases the flow of Boost and Bonus symbols.
3-oaks-gaming-crystal-scarabs.editorial: In Crystal Scarabs, gold scarabs are linked to fixed jackpot levels, while upper Boosters separately change values. Filling the grid doubles the collected result rather than automatically replacing every scarab with Grand.

features.title: Boost collects blue scarabs
features.description: Blue Bonus Symbols contain values that pay when Boost appears at the same time.

features.title: Gold Scarabs and four jackpots
features.description: In Hold & Win, Bonus Gold Symbols can award Mini x20, Minor x50, Major x100 or Grand x5000.

features.title: Upper row of three Boosters
features.description: An additional row offers Plus, Multiplier and Transform. Filling the grid can double the combined bonus result.

features.title: Free Spins with Boost Symbols
features.description: Free Spins increases the probability of Bonus and Boost Symbols and retains the possibility of retriggering Hold & Win.

intro: Fist Symbol expands upwards into a Wild Reel if this creates a win; passing through an opposing Fighter or Wild adds a reel multiplier, and multiple values add together.
In Throwdown, teams earn Victory Points for these hits: every three points raise Victory Level and trigger Epic Drop with a guaranteed number of that team’s Fist Symbols.
hacksaw-gaming-fist-of-destruction.editorial: Fist of Destruction turns ordinary Fist Reels into team progression: each successful hit boosts the current win and brings the team closer to an Epic Drop at a higher Victory Level.

features.title: Fist turns a reel Wild
features.description: A red or blue Fist rises to the top row only with a possible win. Crossing an opposing fighter or Wild gives it a multiplier; multiple Fist values in a combination add together.

features.title: Throwdown: team progression
features.description: Three FS symbols award ten Throwdown Spins. Hits earn Victory Points, and every three points raise Victory Level and trigger Epic Drop with guaranteed team Fist symbols.

features.title: Ultimate Throwdown at level 4+
features.description: Four FS symbols unlock ten Ultimate Throwdown Spins: both teams start at Victory Level 4+. The next increase to 5+ guarantees five Fists in Epic Drop without counting them as new Victory Points.

intro: A special Scatter on the middle reel triggers Feature Wheel with six possible outcomes, including instant prizes and three character features linked to building materials.

Three or more Hard Hat Scatters trigger Free Spins. Hard Hats create frames, repeat landings on the same position upgrade Wood to Brick to Gold, and framed positions become houses revealing instant prizes after the bonus ends.
playn-go-buildin-bucks.editorial: Buildin’ Bucks turns progress into a visible grid state: frames do more than mark positions, upgrading from wood to brick to gold in sequence. The Wheel provides short character events, while Free Spins develops the same system towards a final house reveal.

features.title: Feature Wheel from the central reel
features.description: A special Scatter on the middle reel opens a wheel with six outcomes, including instant prizes and three character building features.

features.title: Hard Hat Scatter and Free Spins
