features.description: Three or more Hard Hat Scatters unlock a bonus where Hard Hats form Frames in grid positions.

features.title: Wood → Brick → Gold
features.description: A repeat hard-hat landing in an occupied cell upgrades its Frame material from wood to brick, then gold.

features.title: House Reveal at the bonus’s end
features.description: When Free Spins ends, constructed Frames become houses and reveal Instant Prizes; the prize is linked to the cell’s final state.

intro: Henry The Ape uses Nudging Super High Symbols on reels 2–5: stacks shift after each turn until leaving the grid. On a non-winning spin, Drop the Win or Rewind can create a new combination.
In free spins, Gold Disks collected from stacks fill Bonus Meter. Every four disks award extra spins and turn an ordinary symbol into Super High.
push-gaming-henry-the-ape.editorial: Henry’s main distinction is dual progression: stacks move between rounds, while Gold Disks in the bonus change the symbol composition across all reels.

features.title: Nudging Super High
features.description: High-paying stacks nudge along the reels and can pay for just two matching symbols.

features.title: Drop the Win and Rewind
features.description: After a non-winning turn, Super High/Wild symbols can be added or reels can respin.

features.title: Gold Disk Meter
features.description: Four disks extend Free Spins and turn the next ordinary symbol into a high-paying Super High.

intro: Black Hawk is a four-reel slot with 54 fixed paylines and a dark fantasy setting. Wins centre on ordinary matches and a Wild that substitutes for standard symbols.
After a winning spin, a separate Gamble offers an attempt to increase the amount received. The provider states neither free spins nor a collection grid for the original Black Hawk.
wazdan-black-hawk.editorial: Black Hawk should be assessed as a payline slot with Wild and Gamble. The later Deluxe reworked its presentation and added interface settings, but no newly verified Jackpot round.

features.title: Four reels, 54 paylines
features.description: An unusual payline count for four reels, but without cascades or game clusters.

features.title: Wild in combinations
features.description: A special Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols and helps complete winning paylines.

features.title: Unique Gamble Feature
features.description: After receiving a win, the player can take a risk and try to increase it in a separate mini-game.

intro: Dancing Joker: Break & Win uses 5×3 and 40 paylines, but its main movement comes from Joker, which appears only in the centre of the third reel.
This Joker acts as both Wild and Collect: it gathers visible coins, fills two piggy-bank meters and stays in position during Free Spins.
3-oaks-gaming-dancing-joker.editorial: Dancing Joker is not ordinary Hold & Win with held coins. Its central Joker links fast collection, free-spins meters and random rewind effects, so bonus progress depends on one specific symbol appearing.

features.title: Joker Wild/Collect on reel 3
features.description: Joker can land only in the central cell of the third reel, substitutes for ordinary symbols and gathers all visible Coin Bonus values.

features.title: Two Free Spins piggy banks
features.description: Joker fills one or two Piggy Bank Metres: filling one awards six spins, while both award twelve. Joker stays held in Free Spins.

features.title: Wild and Bonus Rewind
features.description: Random rewind features can return Joker to the grid or turn symbols into Jackpot Bonus symbols, unlike ordinary payline payouts.

features.title: Fiery rain of bonus coins
features.description: The reels randomly catching fire adds Coin Bonus Symbols for Joker to collect; fixed Mini, Minor, Major and Grand prizes are possible.

intro: Green Chilies reveal adding values only alongside a win and add them in sequence to a Global Multiplier; the entire current-round win is then multiplied by the final value.
Small Menu uses the base rules, while Big Menu makes Global Multiplier progressive: Chili values continue adding between spins and no longer reset after each round.
hacksaw-gaming-freds-food-truck.editorial: Freds Food Truck keeps the bonus mathematics in one meter: multiple Chilies can sharply raise the current spin’s multiplier, while Big Menu turns it from a one-use value into an accumulating resource for the entire bonus.

features.title: Green Chilies and Global Multiplier
features.description: Only with a winning combination do Green Chilies reveal values and add them to Global Multiplier. In the ordinary mode, it multiplies current-round payouts and resets before the next round.

features.title: One, two or three Chilies
features.description: The Chili count on a symbol determines available multipliers: single, double and triple use different ranges. Values reveal left to right and top to bottom, then add together.

features.title: Small Menu and Progressive Big Menu
features.description: Three FS symbols award ten Small Menu Spins with an ordinary multiplier reset. Four FS symbols unlock fifteen Big Menu Spins, where every Green Chili value adds to an accumulated meter that does not reset between spins.

intro: Two Scatter Symbols offer a chance to change the PPS state and trigger the Wheel. The Wheel can select a Character Feature, a prize sector or Wheel Upgrade with a second active wheel.

Three or more Scatters trigger 6 Free Spins and expand the reel set to 5×5. Starting frames depend on triggering Scatters: 3 award Wood Frames, 4 award Brick, and 5 award Gold; a Magic Spin Coin within a frame adds extra Magic Spins.
playn-go-buildin-even-more-bucks.editorial: Buildin’ Even More Bucks extends the earlier building formula in two directions: PPS/Wheel can activate with just two Scatters, while the main bonus physically enlarges the grid to 5×5. The starting frame material depends on trigger strength, so bonus progression does not always begin at the same level.

features.title: PPS and Wheel triggering from two Scatters
features.description: Two Scatters can change the PPS state and activate a wheel with characters, instant rewards and a possible transition to Wheel Upgrade.

features.title: Wheel Upgrade
features.description: The upgrade activates a second Wheel; this is a separate wheel outcome rather than a guaranteed increase in every spin’s win.

features.title: Free Spins on an expanded 5×5 grid
features.description: Three or more Scatters award six Free Spins with grid expansion. With three, four and five Scatters, starting Frames have Wood, Brick and Gold levels.

features.title: Magic Spin Coin in Frames
features.description: An additional Magic Spin Coin landing inside a Frame extends Magic Spins. It should not be transferred to the original Buildin’ Bucks mechanic.

intro: Iron Phoenix adds a separate Phoenix Reel above the main reels with cash values, jackpots and Scatters. In the base game, three Phoenix Symbols on reels 2–4 activate the upper strip’s reward.
Three Scatters trigger Free Spins, where one Phoenix Reel becomes three independent strips. One Phoenix Symbol on the corresponding reel is enough to pay a prize from each strip.
push-gaming-iron-phoenix.editorial: Iron Phoenix’s bonus distinction is more than an abstract increase in landing frequency: the upper reel physically splits into three parts with separate activation conditions.

features.title: Phoenix Reel
features.description: A separate strip above the base game carries Jackpot, Cash and Scatter values.

features.title: Three Phoenix Symbols
features.description: In the base game, Phoenix is required on all three central reels to receive the upper prize.

features.title: Three strips in Free Spins
features.description: One Phoenix on the corresponding reel is enough to collect a separate strip’s prize in the bonus.

intro: Black Hawk Deluxe retains the original’s four-reel grid and 54 paylines but reworks graphics, animation and sound. A white mystical orb becomes Wild and can substitute for the other ordinary symbols.
Wazdan settings are added to standard combinations, including Double Screen Mode and adjustable volatility levels. The special Wild should not be confused with a supposed Scatter bonus.
wazdan-black-hawk-deluxe.editorial: Deluxe is not a new Hold & Win: its verified differences from Black Hawk are a more modern presentation and additional control modes rather than an entirely different grid mathematics.

features.title: White orb Wild
features.description: A special symbol substitutes for ordinary symbols and helps form paylines across four reels.

features.title: Double Screen Mode
features.description: A separate interface setting provides a different way to view the grid.

features.title: 54 paylines and Gamble
features.description: The base grid remains four reels with 54 paylines; Wazdan’s standard gamble game is available after a win.

intro: DJ Tiger x1000 uses a 6×5 grid: eight matching symbols anywhere on it award a payout and trigger cascades.
Disco Ball provides multipliers of up to x1000, Mystery Multiplier reveals after the cascade, and Permanent Wild stays until it ends.
3-oaks-gaming-dj-tiger-x1000.editorial: DJ Tiger x1000 distinguishes ordinary-spin multipliers from the accumulating Total Multiplier in Free Spins. Mystery Multiplier also reveals only after the cascade finishes rather than being a separate value known in advance.

features.title: Scatter Pays and Permanent Wild
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols pay anywhere on the 6×5 grid. Wild remains on screen until the cascade sequence ends.

features.title: Disco Ball Multipliers
features.description: Disco balls can appear independently or be added by the DJ, bringing multipliers of up to x1000 that add together within the spin.

features.title: Mystery Multiplier x10–x1000
features.description: A random Mystery Multiplier reveals its exact value only after the final cascade.

features.title: Free Spins and Bonus Shop
features.description: In Free Spins, winning multipliers add to an overall Total Multiplier; Bonus Shop offers three bonus types, including Mega Free Spins.

intro: Spreading Banana reveals a Wild Multiplier and, with a potential win, stretches copies either left along the row or up the reel; every created copy receives the same multiplier.
In Banana Blitz, Sticky Bananas stay on the grid, while Copied Bananas appear in new positions with their values; if copies overlap in one cell, their multipliers add together.
hacksaw-gaming-frkn-bananas.editorial: FRKN Bananas uses the symbol’s own direction as part of the mechanic: one Banana can build a whole line of matching Wild multipliers, while the bonus adds sticky originals and temporary copies.

features.title: Spreading Banana stretches Wild
features.description: Banana points left along a row or up a reel and replicates to the edge only with a potential win. Every copy inherits the original symbol’s multiplier.

features.title: BANANZA increases the chance of strong Bananas
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger ten BANANZA Spins, with more frequent large multipliers and favourable Spreading Banana positions. Multiple such symbols on one winning payline add their values together.

features.title: Banana Blitz: Sticky and Copied
features.description: Four FS symbols award Banana Blitz with Sticky Bananas that remain until the bonus ends. Go Bananas creates between three and ten copies of each Sticky; multipliers meeting in one cell add together.

intro: Double Wheel offers Character Features and instant prizes; Upgrade activates a second wheel with stronger rewards. Woody Elf, Grout Bricky and Fairy Mary award separate re-spin series working with Wood, Brick and Gold Frames respectively.
Three or more Hard Hat Scatters trigger Magic Spins. Hard Hats build or upgrade frames from Wood to Brick to Gold; after Magic Spins ends, frames become houses and reveal instant prizes.
playn-go-buildin-more-bucks.editorial: Buildin’ More Bucks retains building progression but makes the Wheel the central entry to short character re-spins and direct prizes. Magic Spins uses the same frame system as a longer layer, accumulating grid state until the final transformation into houses.

features.title: Double Wheel and Upgrade
features.description: The wheel selects an instant reward, a character or Upgrade, which activates a second Wheel with enhanced outcomes.

features.title: Woody Elf, Grout Bricky, Fairy Mary
features.description: Three characters provide independent re-spin series linked to Wood, Brick and Gold Frames respectively.

features.title: Magic Spins through hard hats
features.description: Three or more Hard Hat Scatters begin Magic Spins, where hard hats create and upgrade Frames in specific cells.

features.title: From Frames to Prize Houses
features.description: Materials upgrade from Wood to Brick and Gold; after the bonus ends, all constructed Frames become houses with Instant Prizes.

intro: Jaguar Drop pays for six or more matching symbols anywhere on the grid; winning elements disappear and trigger a cascade. Four or five Coins can unlock Second Chance for an attempt to collect the sixth coin.
Six Coins unlock Free Drops with six lives. A row filled with coins restores the counter to six, while Heart can save an extra life; Boost and Collector change coin values.
push-gaming-jaguar-drop.editorial: This is a pay-anywhere game with cascades and separate coin collection. Second Chance is not a guaranteed bonus and does not replace Free Drops itself.

features.title: Second Chance
features.description: With four or five Coins, other symbols can disappear, leaving an attempt to complete the bonus trigger.

features.title: Free Drops
features.description: The series starts with six lives; filling a whole row with coins restores them.

features.title: Heart, Boost and Collector
features.description: Heart adds a life, Boost enhances coins in a 3×3 area, and Collector transfers the total from filled rows into a Coin.

intro: Black Horse is a classic three-reel slot with five paylines and three different bonus symbols. The horse, horseshoe and coins unlock three independent free-spins series.
Collecting nine gold coins awards 15 Free Spins; horseshoes are linked to 30 spins with a x3 multiplier, while the black stallion triggers 45 spins with the same x3.
wazdan-black-horse.editorial: Black Horse’s main feature is three specific bonus paths with different lengths. None is the later Coins series’ Hold the Jackpot bonus.

features.title: Coins: 15 Free Spins
features.description: Nine coin symbols trigger fifteen free spins.

features.title: Horseshoes: 30 Free Spins x3
features.description: Horseshoe Bonus uses thirty spins with a triple multiplier.

features.title: Black horse: 45 Free Spins x3
features.description: Black Horse Bonus awards forty-five spins, boosting standard wins by x3.

intro: Dragon Pearls is the original Chinese-themed game with five reels and twenty-five paylines. Prize pearls form Hold & Win, where coins with cash values lock on the grid.
A separate Free Spins mode exists alongside respins: this series should not be confused with Hold & Win and its fixed Mini, Minor, Major and Grand jackpots.
3-oaks-gaming-dragon-pearls.editorial: This is specifically Dragon Pearls rather than the later 4 Dragon Pearls or 15 Dragon Pearls games. The maximum of 1000x is confirmed by the developer’s separate official profile.

features.title: Five reels and 25 paylines
features.description: Base payline payouts form on a 5×3 grid.

features.title: Pearl Hold & Win
features.description: Special cash symbols trigger a mode with held prizes and respins.

features.title: Free Spins and jackpots
features.description: Separate free spins coexist with fixed Hold & Win jackpot levels.

intro: Super Cascades remove all ordinary symbols of the winning type; if Cheese belongs to a winning cluster, it clears almost the whole grid except FS and Wild Multipliers, then the grid refills.

Jumping Wild Multipliers change position after each cascade: the ordinary variant grows by +1x per jump, Epic by +10x; persistent Jumping Wilds in the bonuses work with Cheese Meter and can advance the round to the next level.
hacksaw-gaming-get-the-cheese.editorial: Get the CHEESE accelerates cascades in two ways: Cheese can clear almost the entire grid, while Jumping Wild Multipliers survive the falling sequence and increase their value with every new move.

features.title: Super Cascades and Cheese Symbol
features.description: After a win, Super Cascades remove every symbol of the winning type. Cheese in a winning cluster clears almost the entire grid except FS and Wild Multipliers, followed by new falling symbols.

features.title: Normal and Epic Jumping Wild
features.description: After a cascade, Wild jumps to a new cell and increases its multiplier. Normal starts at 1x and adds +1x, while Epic starts at 10x and adds +10x; up to four Jumping Wilds can exist together.

features.title: Cheese Meter and Free Spins levels
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger Fromage Frenzy with two persistent Jumping Wilds. Filling Cheese Meter raises the bonus level; Life’s So Gouda guarantees Epic Wild, whose multiplier does not reset between spins.

intro: Benny the Bull acts as Wild and randomly chooses one of three states when appearing. Happy Bull adds 2–6 Wilds, Proud Bull creates 1–5 Stacked Wilds, and Angry Bull adds 2–6 x2 Multiplier Wilds.

Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger 10 Free Spins, preceded by a Happy, Proud or Angry mode choice. The chosen version enhances the corresponding Bull effect; Free Spins can retrigger once for another 10 spins.
playn-go-bull-in-a-china-shop.editorial: Bull in a China Shop builds everything around one Wild character, but his mood changes the intervention on the reels. The bonus partly removes randomness: the player chooses in advance which of three Bull effects will define the entire Free Spins series.

features.title: Benny Bull as Wild
features.description: Benny the Bull substitutes for ordinary symbols and randomly selects one of three mood features when appearing in the base game.

features.title: Happy, Proud and Angry
features.description: Happy adds 2–6 Wilds, Proud creates 1–5 Stacked Wilds, and Angry places 2–6 Wilds with a x2 multiplier.

features.title: Free Spins with a chosen mood
features.description: Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 award ten spins; Happy, Proud or Angry can be selected before the bonus for the entire series.

features.title: One Free Spins extension
features.description: Repeat Scatters can add ten more Free Spins once. This trigger should not be confused with Bull in a Rodeo’s Freedom Round.

intro: Jammin' Jars 2 uses an 8×8 grid: at least five matching fruits are needed for a payout. Gold Vinyl fills the DJ meter, while Instant Prizes form their own winning clusters.
Three Wild Jars trigger six Free Spins. A separate Gold Vinyl meter can activate Giga Jar with a 2×2 figure or a large 3×3/4×4 prize block and eight Giga Spins.
push-gaming-jammin-jars-2.editorial: The sequel differs from the standalone Giga Jar through its Gold Vinyl bonus cycle: after a Giga series, a new Jar appears at the next level rather than necessarily the first.

features.title: Gold Vinyl Meter
features.description: Vinyl records fill the DJ meter until Giga Jar is ready.

features.title: Fruit Blast
features.description: One to three large fruit symbols burst and create new groups on the grid.

features.title: Giga Jar and Free Spins
features.description: Three Wild Jars award 6 Free Spins; a full meter unlocks 8 Giga Spins with large blocks.

intro: Black Horse Cash Out Edition changes the classic western to five reels and 20 paylines with cash coins. Cash Out collects values, while Sticky Cash Out stays on the grid until activating.
Jackpot Coins provide access to four prize levels, including Grand 2500x. Chance Level increases the probability of jackpot symbols at a higher stake.
wazdan-black-horse-cash-out-edition.editorial: This is more than Deluxe with different pictures: two Cash Out variants and Jackpot Coins form its central mechanic; Black Horse Spins should not be attributed to it.

features.title: Ordinary Cash Out
features.description: Collects cash and jackpot coin values landing on the reels.

features.title: Sticky Cash Out
features.description: Stays on the grid for a set time and collects cash symbols when activated.

features.title: Jackpot Coins and Chance Level
features.description: Separate coins lead to four fixed prize levels; Chance Level changes how often they appear.

intro: Egypt Fire 2 returns the pharaohs to a 5×4 grid with twenty paylines. Six Fireball Bonus symbols unlock Hold & Win, where new prize values lock and the grid can grow to eight rows.

After respins, Scarab POWER SYMBOL opens a separate six-cell wheel. Filling the wheel can give the mini-bonus payout a multiplier of up to x10; Scarab Metre provides an alternative entry to Hold & Win.
3-oaks-gaming-egypt-fire-2.editorial: Power Feature is the new part of the second Egypt Fire’s mechanic. The Royal Jackpot for filling the expanded grid should not be confused with the wheel mini-round’s x10 multiplier. Free Spins retains only high-paying symbols.

features.title: Six Fireballs and expansion to 5×8
features.description: Six Bonus symbols trigger Hold & Win, new symbols stay held, and up to four extra rows can lead to Royal 10,000x.

features.title: Scarab POWER Feature
features.description: The scarab opens a six-position mini-bonus; filling its wheel can multiply the prize by up to x10, and it can trigger repeatedly.

features.title: Scarab Metre and Free Spins
features.description: The counter allows Hold & Win to open without the ordinary combination, while Free Spins uses mainly high-paying symbols.

intro: Hunting Season fires five shots at the grid: hit Animal Symbols become Coins or Traps, while the animal’s Stars determine the minimum revealed coin type.
Trap gathers all Coin and other Trap values; a Wild on a shot reel receives a multiplier that then applies to several Coin/Trap values.
hacksaw-gaming-great-game-rockies.editorial: Great Game Rockies builds the round around Hunt events: an Animal’s value depends on its Stars, while Trap turns individual cash symbols into a collection chain. Animal Stars can progress in Free Bird.

features.title: Hunting Season and Animal Stars
features.description: Hunting Season fires five shots at the grid, turning hit Animals into Coins or Traps. Between one and four Stars determine the minimum revealed coin category.

features.title: Traps and multipliers on shot reels
features.description: Trap gathers all Coin and other Trap values. A Wild on a reel hit by a shot can receive a multiplier that applies to individual coins or traps, boosting their cash values.

features.title: Country Strong, Free Bird, Trophy Hunting
features.description: Three FS symbols award Country Strong with more frequent Hunting Season; four FS symbols unlock Free Bird, where a winning Animal gains Stars. Five FS symbols award Trophy Hunting with guaranteed Hunting Season every spin.

intro: On the 5×5 grid, Benny again changes the mechanic according to his mood. Happy adds 2–6 Wilds, while Proud turns Special Bull Wild into a full-reel expanding Wild and can create up to four more Stacked Wilds.

Freedom Round triggers when Locked Gate Scatter and Bull Scatter land on the same spin. Bull breaks the gate, Wilds fill the reels, and each Bull feature in Freedom Spins is followed by three extra Rodeo Bull Wilds.
playn-go-bull-in-a-rodeo.editorial: Bull in a Rodeo does not copy China Shop’s Free Spins: bonus entry requires Gate and Bull Scatter together. Mood effects remain, but Freedom Round adds three more Rodeo Bull Wilds after each event, gradually increasing Wild density.

features.title: 5×5 grid and Bull Mood
features.description: Benny Bull acts as Wild again, but the base 5×5 layout and mood activations differ from China Shop.

features.title: Happy and Proud
features.description: Happy places 2–6 Wilds; Proud expands Special Bull Wild across a full reel and can also create Stacked Wilds.

features.title: Freedom Round from Gate and Bull Scatter
features.description: The bonus starts when Locked Gate and Bull Scatter appear on one spin: the bull breaks the gate and adds Wilds to the reels.

features.title: Three Rodeo Bull Wilds after a feature
features.description: In Freedom Spins, every new Bull feature brings three extra Rodeo Bull Wilds, gradually increasing grid density.

intro: Jiggy’s Pot O’ Gold is a compact 3×3 slot with five paylines. Bonus Symbol in Frame O’ Gold triggers four free spins with nine independent positions for prizes, collectors and Duds.
Golden Clover in Free Spins triggers Reel O’ Plenty, which can increase payouts, add prizes or spins, or award a jackpot. A separate base-game Pot O’ Gold awards six Mighty Craic Free Spins.
push-gaming-jiggys-pot-o-gold.editorial: The two bonus branches differ: the ordinary series uses Frame O’ Gold, while Mighty Craic locks Collector in a special position.

features.title: Frame O’ Gold
features.description: A Bonus Symbol in the frame triggers four spins with nine independent positions.

features.title: Reel O’ Plenty
features.description: Golden Clover opens a wheel with extra Instant Prizes, multipliers, a Jackpot or spins.

features.title: Mighty Craic
features.description: Pot O’ Gold activation awards six turns with a Sticky Collector in the central frame.

intro: Black Horse Deluxe uses six reels and 20 paylines. After a win, Multi Level Wins removes winning symbols and refills empty cells.
Black Horse Spins is a separate bonus; free spins use multipliers. Wazdan does not describe the later version’s Cash Out for this game.
wazdan-black-horse-deluxe.editorial: Deluxe combines the cascading Multi Level Wins structure with its own Black Horse Spins series. Cash coins and Sticky Cash Out belong in the separate Cash Out Edition.

features.title: Multi Level Wins
features.description: Winning symbols disappear, while new ones fill the empty positions to continue the sequence.

features.title: Black Horse Spins
features.description: An independent bonus distinct from ordinary free spins.

features.title: Free spins with a multiplier
features.description: The bonus series offers multiplier-enhanced wins without a cash-coin mechanic.

intro: Egypt Power x1000 uses cascades on an Egyptian grid: symbols disappear after each win and can create another combination in the same spin.
Four Scatters unlock Free Spins, where winning-spin multipliers accumulate in Total Multiplier. Bonus Shop offers four bonus variants, including Epic Free Spins with a starting x100 multiplier.
3-oaks-gaming-egypt-power-x1000.editorial: The x1000 multiplier in the name is not the whole slot’s theoretical win. The official release separately states potential of up to 40,000x. Epic Multi Hunt Booster can guarantee at least x100 with an extra stake, but not a x100 payout.

features.title: Cascades on Egyptian reels
features.description: Paid combinations are removed, and new symbols appear in their places for the next calculation.

features.title: Four Scatters and Total Multiplier
features.description: In Free Spins, winning-spin multipliers add to an overall value until the bonus ends.

features.title: Epic Free Spins and Spin Boosters
features.description: Bonus Shop has four Free Spins types, with Epic starting at x100; separate Boosters change chances and minimum multipliers for an extra payment.

intro: Burning Wild burns symbols above it on the reel when landing: low-paying symbols become Wilds, while high-paying ones become Burnt Wild Multipliers.
FS Symbols carry their own free-spin counts; if an FS burns, its possible value range increases.
hacksaw-gaming-grug-make-fire.editorial: Grug Make Fire uses a vertical chain upwards from Burning Wild: one symbol clears weak positions, turns strong ones into multipliers and can boost an FS value before the bonus.

features.title: Burning Wild burns symbols above
features.description: Burning Wild affects only positions above it on the reel. Low-paying symbols become ordinary Wilds, while high-paying ones become Burnt Wild Multipliers for related wins.

features.title: FS values and burning
features.description: FS Symbols carry upcoming spin counts, and their values add together when the bonus triggers. An ordinary FS shows 2–5, while one touched by Burning Wild can reveal a higher number from 3 to 6.

features.title: Grug Find Food and Grug Fight Dino
features.description: Grug Find Food features more frequent Burning Wilds, while Grug Fight Dino has a progressive Wildfire Bar with rising levels. Collected FS values determine both bonuses’ duration.

intro: M-Counter collects multipliers attached to symbols and turns them into one multiplier for the current round’s total win.

After a non-winning spin, the train can stop and trigger Fortune Frenzy, collecting values from four carriage types. Three or more Bonus Symbols on reels 2–5 trigger Bonus Blitz and switch to an 8-column × 2-row display, where multipliers beneath carriages activate their prizes or a Re-Spin carriage.
playn-go-bullion-xpress.editorial: Bullion Xpress connects its base and bonus mechanics through M-Counter: the accumulated multiplier boosts an ordinary round and can increase carriage-prize values in Fortune Frenzy. Bonus Blitz changes the grid geometry itself and requires a multiplier to land directly beneath the relevant carriage.

features.title: M-Counter and attached multipliers
features.description: M-Counter collects multipliers from game symbols and applies their total to the current ordinary round’s result.

features.title: Fortune Frenzy after an empty spin
features.description: With no win, the train sometimes stops, triggering collection of prize values from four different carriages.

features.title: Bonus Blitz on an 8×2 grid
features.description: Three or more Bonus Symbols on reels 2–5 switch the game to eight columns and two rows with carriage rewards.

features.title: Multipliers beneath carriages
features.description: In Bonus Blitz, a multiplier must stop beneath the corresponding carriage to activate its prize or Re-Spin carriage.

intro: Joker Troupe uses 4×3 and ten paylines with red, green and blue Joker Scatters. Three Jokers of one colour trigger the corresponding bonus with its own structure.
Blue hats lock and open extra rows; green Joker spins a coin-and-multiplier wheel; red activates Hypermode, where Free Spins follow a timer rather than a fixed count.
push-gaming-joker-troupe.editorial: The three Joker colours are not interchangeable Scatters. Hypermode starts at 20 seconds, speeds up spins and can extend after the meter fills.

features.title: Blue Joker Hats
features.description: Held Hats and Red Joker expand the grid when three new symbols accumulate.

features.title: Green Joker Wheel
features.description: The coin wheel adds wins and multipliers, while special segments can unlock Red Joker.

features.title: Red Joker Hypermode
features.description: The bonus is time-controlled: new red Jokers increase speed and fill the timer-reset meter.

intro: Book of Faith uses five reels and ten paylines. Three books unlock between 10 and 30 free spins, with a special expanding symbol assigned beforehand.
The expanding symbol becomes a cash symbol in the bonus, while Collector transfers values into chests above the reels. Collect to Infinity removes the collector-counter limit until the series ends.
wazdan-book-of-faith.editorial: Symbol expansion has a dual role here: it first creates payline wins, then becomes value for Collector. This is not the same bonus as Relic Hunters.

features.title: Expanding book
features.description: The symbol assigned before the bonus covers an entire reel and can then become a cash symbol.

features.title: Collector and chests
features.description: The collector transfers cash values into separate chests, which pay after the bonus.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: A special enhancement extends collector activity until free spins end.

intro: Fishin' Bear is a fishing game with five reels and twenty-five paylines. Bear Wild appears in the middle of the third reel and activates COLLECT if prize fish are nearby.
In Free Spins, he locks in the centre of the grid; one full boat meter awards 8 spins, while both award 16. Fish on the fifth reel become Sticky and change value between spins.
3-oaks-gaming-fishin-bear.editorial: Unlike ordinary Hold & Win, Collect is tied to the bear itself and its third-reel position here. Grand Jackpot of up to 1000x refers to a bonus event rather than a guaranteed catch.

features.title: Bear Wild collects fish
features.description: Bear Wild on the third reel activates collection of bonus-fish values.

features.title: Eight or sixteen Free Spins
features.description: One full boat meter awards 8 bonus spins, while both together award 16.

features.title: Sticky Fish and Rewind
features.description: The bear stays held in Free Spins, fifth-reel fish change values, and Fish Rewind can add up to three jackpot symbols.

intro: Ro$ Symbols expand downwards to the reel’s bottom edge, while Hot Ro$ covers the entire reel; every occupied position counts as Wild.
If Hot Ro$ expands beside an ordinary Ro$, the neighbouring symbol moves to the top and also covers the entire reel; passing through a Wild adds a multiplier to the expanded symbol.
hacksaw-gaming-hot-ross.editorial: Hot Ross builds combinations through chain expansion of whole reels: Hot Ro$ can pull neighbouring Ro$ symbols upwards, while crossing a Wild also turns that expansion into a multiplier reel.

features.title: Ro$ and Hot Ro$ occupy reels
features.description: Ro$ expands downwards, while Hot Ro$ covers the entire reel. A neighbouring Ro$ beside an expanded Hot Ro$ moves upwards and also becomes a full Wild Reel.

features.title: Multipliers for crossing Wild
features.description: An expanding Ro$ or Hot Ro$ passing through an existing Wild creates a multiplier for all wins involving the new Wild Reel. Several reels can be enhanced at the same time.

features.title: Nine Lives and Activated Reels
features.description: In Nine Lives, Ro$ or Hot Ro$ appearing activates its reel until the mode ends. A new Ro$ or Hot Ro$ is guaranteed there on each subsequent spin.

intro: Three matching Contestant symbols on a payline trigger Candy Splash: that Contestant expands and pays across all five paylines. Mixed Contestant combinations do not activate Candy Splash in the base game.

Three Camera Scatters trigger Behind the Scenes with one of six instant wins from x5 to x2000 the bet. Two Ticket Scatters award a Lucky Re-Spin of the third reel, while three trigger Free Spins; mixed Contestants can activate Candy Splash in the bonus, and each series is followed by Jelly Jiggle Delight with a chance of a x2 multiplier for the whole Free Spins session.
playn-go-candy-island-princess.editorial: Candy Island Princess assigns three Scatter mechanics different roles: Camera immediately awards an instant prize, two Tickets provide a re-spin chance to find the third, and three Tickets unlock Free Spins. Bonus Candy Splash broadens by allowing mixed Contestant combinations.

features.title: Candy Splash from three matching Contestants
features.description: Three matching contestants on one payline expand and pay across all five paylines; mixed Contestants do not trigger this effect in the base game.

features.title: Behind the Scenes from Camera Scatter
features.description: Three Camera Scatters trigger one of six instant prizes: x5, x10, x20, x80, x500 or x2000 the stake.

features.title: Lucky Re-Spin and Free Spins from Tickets
features.description: Two Ticket Scatters allow the third reel to respin for another Ticket; three Tickets trigger Free Spins.

features.title: Jelly Jiggle Delight
features.description: Mixed Contestants can activate Candy Splash in Free Spins. After the series, choosing one of three options can award x2 to the entire bonus win.

intro: Mad Blast uses cascading pay-anywhere wins: eight matching symbols pay, while Total Multiplier doubles with every successful cascade up to x2048.
On an empty cascade, Extra Life clears most symbol types and can continue the series. Three to five Mad Heads trigger between eight and twelve free spins with their own starting multiplier.
push-gaming-mad-blast.editorial: Mad Blast does not apply a static x2048 on every turn: its counter grows only through successful cascade chains and resets after a non-winning drop.

features.title: Total Multiplier Meter
features.description: Doubles after a winning cascade and resets when the sequence ends.

features.title: Multiplier Boost and Extra Life
features.description: Boost raises the meter several steps, while Extra Life can remove surplus symbol types after an unsuccessful cascade.

features.title: Free Spins with Strike Out
features.description: Mad Heads award a starting multiplier and turns, while three winning cascades remove one level from the meter.

intro: Bumba Meu Boi Coin centres on one main reel and three small upper reels. Magic Coin appears only in the upper row and reveals additional hidden cells behind it.
Collected symbols stay on the rear matrix until Boi Da Fortuna Bonus. Extra Life can add up to three bonus spins at the start, while Chance Level changes the entry probability.
wazdan-bumba-meu-boi-coin.editorial: This is an independent Coins architecture rather than an ordinary nine-coin grid: Magic Coin controls opening a second reel layer here.

features.title: Magic Coin
features.description: Upper-row coins reveal the rear mini-reel matrix and preserve collected symbols.

features.title: Boi Da Fortuna
features.description: Symbols accumulated on the second layer contribute to a separate bonus round.

features.title: Extra Life and Chance Level
features.description: Extra lives increase the starting series, while Chance Level adjusts bonus probability at a higher stake.

intro: Fortune Globe is a mystical slot on a 5×4 grid with twenty paylines, where six bonus globes unlock Hold & Win with three respins.

Collecting 10, 15, 20 and 25 Bonus Globes opens the fifth, sixth, seventh and eighth rows. Filling one extra row awards a multiplier of up to x10, while filling the expanded grid unlocks the Royal Jackpot of 10,000x.
3-oaks-gaming-fortune-globe.editorial: This has five fixed jackpots and a separate Royal for filling forty positions. Candle Metre works even in Free Spins and can unlock Hold & Win, but should not be treated as guaranteeing Royal.

features.title: Four expansion stages
features.description: Accumulating 10/15/20/25 bonus globes opens one extra row at a time up to a 5×8 grid.

features.title: Multiplier rows and Royal
features.description: A full extra row boosts values by up to x10; filling the whole grid awards the Royal Jackpot of 10,000x.

features.title: Candles Metre and eight Free Spins
features.description: Filled candles provide an alternative Hold & Win entry; three Scatters unlock eight Free Spins with high-paying symbols and retriggers.

intro: Hellhound spreads upwards along its reel, after which its adding or multiplying values collect from bottom to top into a separate reel total.
Horizontally neighbouring Hellhounds form a Roaring Pack with enhanced value ranges; Hounds are Loose removes low-paying symbols and increases the chance of new Hellhounds.
hacksaw-gaming-hounds-of-hell.editorial: Hounds of Hell calculates its cash result through an ordered expression on each reel rather than one coin: adding and multiplying Hellhounds change the reel total in a strict order, while Roaring Pack boosts their ranges.

features.title: Hellhounds add and multiply values
features.description: Hellhound expands upwards along its reel. Adding and Multiplying values are processed in sequence from bottom to top; individual reel results then add together and convert into a cash payout.

features.title: Roaring Pack and Hounds Are Loose
features.description: Horizontally neighbouring Hellhounds form a Roaring Pack with higher values. Hounds Are Loose removes low-paying symbols and increases the chance of new Hellhounds after the grid refreshes.

features.title: What the Hell and Who Let the Hounds Out
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock a bonus accumulating multipliers above the reels until the mode ends. Four FS symbols trigger a bonus with persistent Hell Reels that guarantee Hellhound on every subsequent spin.
